clean_body: I grew up working on the farm in Nash County, every summer until I went to college. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more | | | Aug 4 | | | | | | | | | | | | I grew up working on the farm in Nash County, every summer until I went to college. Those years taught me firsthand what farming means to this state -- not just as a livelihood, but as the foundation of our rural communities. Local farms put safe, healthy food on tables across every corner of North Carolina. They drive our state's economy and help supply food banks that serve families in underprivileged communities. Local farmers keep North Carolina moving forward. But right now, that legacy is being threatened. The federal government's chaotic, erratic tariffs are driving up the costs of equipment, machinery, fertilizer and other essentials that farms depend on. Across the state, I've heard from farmers who are being forced to scale back what they grow. And some are even considering taking a season off from planting altogether. Earlier this year, I sat down with Pender, a fourth-generation farmer in Wilson County. His family has endured decades of change, but he told me this moment feels different. With rising inflation, high fuel prices and the added strain of new tariffs, keeping his farm running has never been harder. And Pender's story isn't unique: farmers across North Carolina are facing the same uphill battle. You can listen to Pender's story here. Agriculture is the number one driver of our economy in North Carolina and our farmers are the backbone. Just last week, I spoke with North Carolina farmers and rural leaders on how we can best support our farms across the state. I'm running for the U.S. Senate to make sure that our farmers have someone in Washington who understands their challenges and will fight for them. If you're ready to join me, thank you for a few dollars when you can, vote, or to knock on doors. All of it matters. * You can also hear Pender's story . | | | | | | | (C) 2026 Roy Cooper PO Box 1190, Raleigh, NC 27602 ? ?

subject: I put everything into my last message - but it fell flat.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Brandon Gill for Texas
body:
I’m trusting that these words will inspire you.

| |
---
| | [](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckD2O2zAQRk9DdTQokqatgkUAw6k22S6lMCuO5AH4B3LkjW8fKEEusN0UDw_zvl9v8xtQpLz9gIR-K7XOrc9Ud8Ynthc_KG-UuaRXhM5p1ko7qa5S2RkWpifOFobgLTjrnBvQj5fr-XrWk3LDwxtY9IKrXWGcPnTQl8lAuOjVoAEcx2kgfwjVVdnRjmdlT2ennF6n1bmg3IRKWIWBuLTT8VvDTgEzE8TTUtIQ_YO5dmG-CX0X-t5x2RuePik3DAch9P2jQQ4ly41ilGtpkvE39AOGhLWVRB25vMou-VUxQA4N_16YJCZZQR9uc2-Hu1HehLlx21Fot3OaeRHm9v3n-7v8XyK0g8S1dGIqWZjbODQf6ifFSN1dhFVbAvoXwF-d_On1nwAAAP__AT-UbQ)
---
Patriot, I typed and re-typed this message 5 or 6 times before hitting send... There’s so much to say, and it’s difficult to find all the words. I put everything into my last message - _**but it fell flat. **_ In a way, I feel like this is the text I'm being called me to send. So I’m trusting that these words will inspire you. Patriot, this is Rep. Brandon Gill and at 29 years old, I decided to run for Congress where I became the youngest House Republican. **[I never imagined that just a few years later, I’d be sending a final message like this one pleading for your help.](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckD2O2zAQRk9DdTQokqatgkUAw6k22S6lMCuO5AH4B3LkjW8fKEEusN0UDw_zvl9v8xtQpLz9gIR-K7XOrc9Ud8Ynthc_KG-UuaRXhM5p1ko7qa5S2RkWpifOFobgLTjrnBvQj5fr-XrWk3LDwxtY9IKrXWGcPnTQl8lAuOjVoAEcx2kgfwjVVdnRjmdlT2ennF6n1bmg3IRKWIWBuLTT8VvDTgEzE8TTUtIQ_YO5dmG-CX0X-t5x2RuePik3DAch9P2jQQ4ly41ilGtpkvE39AOGhLWVRB25vMou-VUxQA4N_16YJCZZQR9uc2-Hu1HehLlx21Fot3OaeRHm9v3n-7v8XyK0g8S1dGIqWZjbODQf6ifFSN1dhFVbAvoXwF-d_On1nwAAAP__AT-UbQ)** You could say I prefer the simple things in life. I grew up on a cattle ranch and television isn’t my pastime. Being a husband and a father are the two most important things in my life. Sometimes, when I'm holding my kids I feel like I'm holding the whole world in my arms. **They are the wind in my sails when it comes to the mission I’ve committed my life & career to. ** And at the end of my life, I want to sit before the Father almighty and declare that I did all I could to leave this great country better off than it was when I grew up. _**[Nothing – I repeat – nothing is more important to me than fighting off the vicious leftist attacks against the soul of our country.](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckD2O2zAQRk9DdTQokqatgkUAw6k22S6lMCuO5AH4B3LkjW8fKEEusN0UDw_zvl9v8xtQpLz9gIR-K7XOrc9Ud8Ynthc_KG-UuaRXhM5p1ko7qa5S2RkWpifOFobgLTjrnBvQj5fr-XrWk3LDwxtY9IKrXWGcPnTQl8lAuOjVoAEcx2kgfwjVVdnRjmdlT2ennF6n1bmg3IRKWIWBuLTT8VvDTgEzE8TTUtIQ_YO5dmG-CX0X-t5x2RuePik3DAch9P2jQQ4ly41ilGtpkvE39AOGhLWVRB25vMou-VUxQA4N_16YJCZZQR9uc2-Hu1HehLlx21Fot3OaeRHm9v3n-7v8XyK0g8S1dGIqWZjbODQf6ifFSN1dhFVbAvoXwF-d_On1nwAAAP__AT-UbQ)**_ The left hates you, they hate your vote, and they hate MAGA for putting America First. ## The Road to the Fighting Ninth: A Journey of Hope and Heart:
__ _by Alexa Casey_
## A Moment of Reflection from the Campaign
I remember when this was just one person with a conviction and a lot of heart.
I was there at the very beginning — before the yard signs, before the canvassing routes, before the phone banks and post cards written after long work days. I watched Adam walk into rooms where nobody knew his name, introduce himself with nothing but sincerity and purpose, and leave with people leaning forward in their chairs, nodding, believing. That was the beginning. And even then, I knew it was something.
What I have witnessed since those early days is nothing short of remarkable. I have seen Adam grow from a first-time candidate finding his footing into a tireless, fearless voice for Southwest Virginia. Every single week, he was learning about the issues more deeply, learning the communities, learning the names of people’s children and the names of their towns. He drove the length and breadth of the Fighting Ninth not because it was required of him, but because he genuinely believed that every corner of this district deserved to be seen, heard, and fought for. From the listening sessions in Bristol, where residents poured out their frustrations and their hopes, to the town halls in Wise County and the community gatherings in Big Stone Gap, Adam showed up. He always showed up.
He found ways to reach people that campaigns like this simply don’t attempt. He knocked on doors in communities that had long stopped expecting anyone to knock. He sat across kitchen tables in coal country and listened — really listened — to what it means to watch a region you love slowly hollow out. He heard the stories of families rationing insulin because the cost of staying alive has become a luxury. He heard from young people who love this land but cannot find work worthy of the lives they want to build here. He heard from parents in counties where you can no longer have a baby safely, because thirteen out of twenty-eight counties in this district have lost their OB-GYN units.He took all of it in, and he carried it with him to every next stop on the road.
And then there are the volunteers. I have to talk about the volunteers, because they are the soul of this campaign.
These are people who gave up their evenings and their weekends. People who showed up tired from their own long weeks and still knocked on doors with a smile and a purpose.We laughed together, we shared stories and we were determined to make a difference for SWVA. We gathered to assemble grab bags for canvassing events, stuffing pins and stickers, knowing that every single bag represented a constituent or neighbor we were going to meet, a vote we were going to earn. There was something almost sacred about those moments. Nobody was there for glory or recognition.Everyone was there because they believed in Adam, in Southwest Virginia, in one another and in the idea that things do not have to stay the way they are.
Over 200 volunteers. Over 10,000 doors. Every county and city in the district touched by this campaign. That is not a statistic. That is a movement.
---
And the message that has resonated in every one of those conversations is the same. Southwest Virginia is becoming unaffordable, and the people who live here deserve a representative who will fight to change that: not one who has spent sixteen years looking the other way. Adam’s platform is rooted in that truth. Medicare-for-All, so that no family ever has to choose between a prescription and a heating bill. A living wage and a 21st Century Deal that brings real jobs and real economic investment back to this region. Affordable housing, clean energy, and infrastructure that finally connects these communities to the modern economy. And not a single dollar of it beholden to corporate PACs, billionaire donors, or foreign interests. This campaign belongs to the people and that is exactly who it will serve.
Morgan Griffith has held this seat since 2011. Sixteen years. And in sixteen years, the hospitals have closed, the young people have left, the costs have climbed, and the neglect has deepened. We are not just angry about that. We are determined. We are more energized and more united than we have ever been, because we have spent months on the ground in this district and we know what is possible when people decide enough is enough.
The primary on August 4th is the first step. But make no mistake — our eyes are on November. Defeating Morgan Griffith is not a long shot. It is our mission. And every door knocked, every grab bag assembled, every hour volunteered has been in service of that mission.
The doors have been knocked. The conversations have been had. The miles have been driven. Now it is your turn.
Today, vote in the primary on August 4th, 2026. And then, when November comes, we finish what we started — together.
**_“We have always held to the hope,the belief, the conviction that there is a better life, a better world, beyond the horizon.” — Franklin D. Roosevelt_**
## Vote Adam Murphy for Congress.Because Southwest Virginia is worth fighting for — and November is ours to win. A future WE ALL deserve.
---

---
**If you have been waiting for the right moment to get involved, this is that moment.**
Join us by signing up here: www.murphy4va.com/volunteer.
Thank you to every volunteer, supporter, voter, and community member who has welcomed us, challenged us, communicated a story, or offered encouragement. And for those who can donate in these tough times, your money has been spent on materials and expenses, not consultants and gala events. I feel hopeful because I have seen the strength, generosity, and determination of the people of Southwest Virginia.
Democracy requires participation. Let us finish this primary with purpose, come together afterward, and push forward with everything we have. Because the Ninth District belongs to its people, together we can guarantee that its representation does too.
**Here’s to a Future We All Deserve!**

Peter, I expect this to be the most expensive and competitive Senate race in the country. Remember, this is Georgia. This race is pivotal.
This race matters! The outcome will have a profound impact on our immediate circumstances _and_ on the long future — for our state, our nation, and our world.
And over and over throughout American history, Georgia — the cradle of the Civil Rights Movement — has been a place where courageous people on the right side of history have made a transformative impact.
So, not for the sake of my career ... and not for the sake of the Democratic Party ... but for the sake of our country: These final weeks in Georgia matter an awful lot.
If that’s all you need to hear, use this link to chip in to my reelection campaign today: [**https://act.electjon.com/go/Georgia**](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-aug26.Gm-cyv&refcode=em260804-1-subs&utm_campaign=em260804-1-subs&t=2&akid=2627%2E5691347%2EDlB1_M)
Look, there is no path back to the majority — and therefore to real accountability for all this obscene corruption and abuse — without winning this Senate race.
And I am facing a man, MAGA extremist Mike Collins, who is unfit for _any_ office.
Trump and his big money MAGA machine will do whatever it takes to replace me with his puppet, who is pro-war, pro-tariff, and pro-cutting your health care.
Before my election to the U.S. Senate, I led a team that investigated and exposed war crimes, human rights abuses, official corruption and organized crime for international news organizations.
We helped courageous journalists smuggle the truth out of repressive societies with authoritarian governments.
And more and more, the United States under Donald Trump reminds me of those places.
That’s why we need to send a massive message this fall — a message so clear and a rebuke so decisive this fall that no president — of any party! — will dare anything like this again ... for centuries.
_That's_ the opportunity that we have this November.
And that will be a great service to our Republic.

# **RFK Jr. EXPLODES at CNN 's Dana Bash, shuts her down on her own show**
HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. had **[a heated exchange with CNN anchor Dana Bash](https://substack.com/redirect/adb72019-19fd-4dae-b19e-109f3cb5e6c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on Sunday over rising US measles cases and his role in vaccine hesitancy.
_" I can see you're flustered now!!" _
## [Watch here:](https://substack.com/redirect/adb72019-19fd-4dae-b19e-109f3cb5e6c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/adb72019-19fd-4dae-b19e-109f3cb5e6c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Click To Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/adb72019-19fd-4dae-b19e-109f3cb5e6c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Kennedy rejected personal responsibility for the outbreak,** arguing the US is outperforming other developed nations including Mexico, Canada, and the UK on a per capita basis, and pointing to Fauci's private diary entries suggesting COVID lockdowns and renewed distrust in Big Pharma drove drops in childhood vaccination rates.

* **Pressed by Bash to directly encourage parents to vaccinate their children, Kennedy agreed:** "People should get their children vaccinated for measles. A measles vaccine is effective. It stops measles in about 97% of cases." He also called out Bash for rolling her eyes during his comments about vaccine-autism research.
* **The interview grew tense when Kennedy accused CNN of committing "press malpractice"** during COVID and asked Bash whether her job was to end vaccine hesitancy or tell the truth. CNN defended Bash's performance in a statement afterward.

# **Mamdani kicks business leaders to the curb, fires entire advisory board of major NYC fund**
NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani **[disbanded the entire advisory board](https://substack.com/redirect/7ac7aadb-04b4-4b2b-a2bf-8887bc45c882?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** of the Mayor's Fund to Advance New York City, a nonprofit that channels private sector donations into city initiatives. The mass dismissal, the first in at least three mayoral administrations, removed prominent business leaders including executives from Blackstone, Citigroup, GFP Real Estate, and the Real Estate Board of New York.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7ac7aadb-04b4-4b2b-a2bf-8887bc45c882?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The Mayor 's Fund has raised hundreds of millions of dollars since 1995,** including $107 million for families of rescue workers killed on September 11 and $54.5 million in COVID-19 emergency relief. The fund currently holds $16.4 million in cash. Mamdani's office said it would announce a new advisory board later this year, framing the overhaul as a shift toward community representation over business influence.
* **The move continues Mamdani 's pattern of antagonizing New York's business community,** following earlier decisions including rent freezes, luxury property taxes, and public confrontations with billionaire executives.

| | Two Moms Turn Heartbreak Into a Mission to Save Lives

| [](https://momsforamerica.us/so/d7P-D1WNS/c?w=PtmP6VOZc0WKRk0upTDk0L1FxzYNvPTGpMADU3KyBzc.)

| | No parent imagines they will outlive their child, yet far too many moms are facing the unimaginable because of the overdose crisis. This week on the Moms for America Podcast, you'll hear two powerful conversations recorded at CPAC with moms who have turned devastating loss into a mission to save lives. Many know Jackie Siegel as the "Queen of Versailles," but behind the public persona is a grieving mother who lost her daughter, Victoria, to an overdose. Today, Siegel is helping spare other families from the same tragedy through the Victoria's Voice Foundation.The conversation continues with Anne Fundner, whose son Weston died after taking a counterfeit pill laced with fentanyl. Since sharing her family's story at the 2024 Republican National Convention, Fundner has become a leading voice educating parents about the dangers of fentanyl and the importance of prevention. Their stories are heartbreaking, but their message is filled with hope: together, we can raise awareness, protect our children, and help save lives. Full episode available now on [YouTube](https://momsforamerica.us/so/d7P-D1WNS/c?w=GaollsGbP6V0Ffyl3rruBgAaFNL8EFcjUoaTLccTdC0.), [Rumble](https://momsforamerica.us/so/d7P-D1WNS/c?w=o1cMsZ1KVCCzuJvzRFoUbQJ34yHMt4tje1Lpm7pnFns.), [Spotify](https://momsforamerica.us/so/d7P-D1WNS/c?w=kgfGp2zaAesQT6Qvm7mH050er0jDMraU8gyLoMVNhC4.) and [Apple](https://momsforamerica.us/so/d7P-D1WNS/c?w=Vo2M2zESo9BM_wda0xZwlF45YTnE4yvul1RtFBFa0t0.).

| | | |

| | 4 Practical Ways to Help Your Kids Avoid Drug Addiction
---
| [](https://momsforamerica.us/so/d7P-D1WNS/c?w=GNw81mlNzZNUbK3yGFCzyLnamQd6sVyHyZ_JhvmnePI.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubW9tc2ZvcmFtZXJpY2EudXMvYmxvZyIsInIiOiI0ZWExMjdiNy03YmViLTQyMzMtODlkYy05Njk4MDZjMTUxN2MiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiJiMzgzOGJmOC1mYWIwLTQxYjktOTY3My1lOGM2YmVmYjY1NzcifQ)

| | Every mom wants to believe her child is immune to the dangers of drug addiction. But today's reality tells a different story. Since 1999, more than 1.25 million Americans have lost their lives to drug-related deaths, and many addictions begin with what seems like a harmless first experiment. Protecting our children starts long before they face those life-altering decisions. It begins at home. Healthy families are built on intentional relationships, clear expectations, honest conversations, and unwavering faith. Children who see self-control modeled by their parents, understand family boundaries, know they can come to Mom with difficult questions, and are grounded in God's truth are better equipped to navigate the pressures they'll encounter. No family can eliminate every risk, but moms have tremendous influence. Every conversation, every prayer, every boundary, and every example helps shape the choices our children will make. Together, we can raise a generation that is prepared to stand firm, make wise decisions, and choose a future filled with hope. Read the [full blog](https://momsforamerica.us/so/d7P-D1WNS/c?w=buIUskpD_xVGvZp6z6Jc6GDTiN-XH59QAjRFwxnaejM.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubW9tc2ZvcmFtZXJpY2EudXMvYmxvZyIsInIiOiJjYTM2NzZhZS1lZWNlLTQ2MTUtODU0ZS00MWExMmZiMmM3ZTUiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiJiMzgzOGJmOC1mYWIwLTQxYjktOTY3My1lOGM2YmVmYjY1NzcifQ) for four practical ways to help protect your family from the dangers of drug addiction.

body:
One step closer

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/3cdf5820dc39/breaking-news-citizens-only-voting-amendment-submitted-to-board-of-canvassers-8371857?e=ecf60db114)
---
[|
---](https://onlycitizens.vote/michigan/)
| | | | | [DONATE TODAY](https://secure.winred.com/americans-for-citizen-voting-michigan/donate-today)
---
|
---
| | Fellow Michigander,
The challenge period for our Citizen Only Voting petition has officially begun.
The Board of State Canvassers has completed its initial review of our petition, confirming **709,841 signatures collected across 118,599 petition pages**. A random sample of 1,000 signatures has now been selected for verification, and we need at least 629 valid signatures in that sample to qualify for the November ballot.
We are confident we will meet that threshold.
As expected, opponents have until **August 7 at 5:00 p.m.** to challenge our petition. We fully anticipate they will. Our legal team is prepared to respond to every challenge, and we look forward to a final certification vote at the **August 24 meeting of the Board of State Canvassers**.
But while our attorneys defend the petition, it's time for the rest of us to prepare for what's next.
Once Citizen Only Voting is certified, the campaign will move into full swing. Every news story, social media post, letter to the editor, and conversation with friends and neighbors will matter. That's why we're building our **Rapid Response Team** now.
When important stories break or misinformation spreads, we'll send you the facts, talking points, and simple ways you can help share our message. A few minutes of your time can make a tremendous difference in helping educate voters across Michigan.
**If you're ready to be part of our Team, simply reply to this email and let us know you're in. We need canvassers, donors, social media warriors, LTE drafters, and everything in between.**
We couldn't have come this far without your support, and we're excited for the next phase of this campaign. Together, we'll make sure Michigan voters have the opportunity to decide this important issue in November.
Thank you for standing with us.
The Citizen Only Voting Michigan Team
**P.S.** While we are confident we will prevail during the challenge process, defending the petition requires significant legal resources. If you're able to make a contribution today, your support will help ensure we're ready for every challenge—and every step of the campaign ahead.

---

But when one of their own is accused of violence against his family, suddenly those values disappear.
There is always an excuse.

This is the moral rot at the heart of the MAGA movement -- and it is exactly what we are fighting to defeat.

body:
I want to tell you a story that doesn't get told enough.

| | | Patriot, **I’ve learned a thing or two in Washington about how to utterly demolish the radical left's arguments -- and my strategy is so simple that my 3-year-old could do it.** The radical left completely breaks down when you do this one simple thing: **_You ask them_**** _simple, obvious questions_**** _with conviction and don't let them dodge._** [**If you're reading this right now, there's a good chance you know my name because I've gone viral for doing exactly this.**](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLvO3CAQRp8Gd6y4mcUFRZSVpRR_yqS0WJj1PxIXB7A3jx8RKS-QborROTrfz4_tw2HEvH93Cay_cKttayVByXAUzB2C6wlcDt7FuAkmNGWGMrU53_GCTbkpWB-0FBNYfjezmfUs5-nTCgZcgoGXWGbB7qC5MMorL41hYVn4hHbgmGGKz3zm5ub5Uy7A-aKcfmowRLHzCK5Du_mSG9TLDSfmXMZV8s2XNEX72fvRiPxCxErE2sCfFW5vzBXC-CBifVaXQ8l0xxjpq1Ta4bdrRKwRXr2VGPrI8bRhOiKU54XlbL9OaMPSKCR6uEGXax30inkn8tHrCUTos6eteyIfX398o_-SiNAu9aM0HAgiH3yqNhxvjBGbvhPF9uQw_i3o_zn8ZcWfAAAA__9Ud5XU) It's Congressman Brandon Gill, and I want to tell you a story of when I first chose to come face to face with the radical left’s evil insanity. body:
We need to elect more Democrats to stand up to billionaires and corporate bad actors
#
Peter,
Minnesota led the way in passing a first-in-the-nation law to ban websites, apps, and software from “nudifying” images and videos of people. It’s a commonsense step to protect privacy and, most importantly, keep our children safe from predators.
But Big Tech billionaire Elon Musk has a problem with that.
Since December, his **xAI Grok AI tools have allowed users to create _thousands_ of sexualized images and videos** of people, including removing their clothing, without their consent.
So instead of doing the right thing and making his technology comply with the law, **he decided to file a federal lawsuit against Minnesota to stop it. This was Tim’s response:**
[](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260804-1.JuplLj&amount=5&refcode=em20260804-931&t=2&akid=931%2E34582%2Ejty26K)
So far, a judge has denied Musk’s request to stop this nudification ban from going into effect, but there will be another hearing on August 19th, and the court could still pause this law at a later time.
This isn’t okay, Peter, and that’s why Tim is fighting back. In this worsening oligarchy, billionaires and corporations think they can do whatever they want to make a profit at the expense of real people, and right-wing politicians like Donald Trump have enabled them.
**It’s just one of countless reasons why we need to elect more Democratic leaders to office to stand up for our families and hold bad actors like Musk accountable.**
**[Will you help Tim and Small Town PAC support Democrats running in this November’s midterm elections by pitching in $5 or more today?](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260804-1.JuplLj&amount=5&refcode=em20260804-931&t=3&akid=931%2E34582%2Ejty26K)**

Thanks for being in our corner,
The Small Town PAC Team

Tim Walz started Small Town PAC to build a Democratic Party that invests in small towns and delivers a message that resonates with rural America.
Together, we're finding and recruiting thoughtful, hardworking people to run for office, and supporting a new generation of leaders who truly reflect and understand their communities.
**[It’s time for Democrats to expand the map and put small towns back at the forefront: pitch in now to help build our movement from the ground up.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/stp-ms-em-footer?refcode=em20260804-931&t=23&refcode2=931_34582_jty26K&akid=931%2E34582%2Ejty26K)**

name: Sean Feucht
subject: 2026: Where we've been and where we're going next!
body:
| | |
---
| |
---
---
Here, there and everywhere... that's the best way to describe 2026!

It's impossible to encapsulate all God's done this year in one short email. So instead of telling you, I'm going to show you with three maps.

This first map is 2026 Roots of Revival stops _so far_. Each red pin represents one city — but countless testimonies and stories of God moving!
---
---
|
---
Let's pull back the lens. Let Us Worship has a heart for the nations, and we've made it a priority to bring revival wherever God calls us.

And we've answered that call, even though it means hostile nations, war zones and places where accepting Christ is a dangerous decision.
---
---
|
---
Are we done yet? No chance. In fact, we're only halfway done with our _Roots of Revival_ tour. The blue pins below are cities we are still headed to this year!

God's moved powerfully this year, and He's not done yet. In fact, we believe He's just getting started!
---

name: Vera Smith
subject: Our wildest places are on the line: Tell the federal government not to weaken wildland protections!
body:
Urge the Department of the Interior not to roll back wildlands protections

Urge the Department of the Interior not to roll back wildlands protections
                  

(https://support.defenders.org/s/5844474/38SyG9Xl)

(https://support.defenders.org/s/5844475/38SyG9Xl)

Tell the Department of Interior Keep our lands protected! (https://support.defenders.org/s/5844476/38SyG9Xl)

Defender,

Millions of acres of wild places in National Parks, Refuges, and other national lands are under threat as the Department of the Interior carries out a sweeping policy review.

Federal agencies need to hear from us before this review ends. Click here to send a message saying you want wilderness-quality lands to remain protected! (https://support.defenders.org/s/5844477/38SyG9Xl)

Wilderness policies are under review at three federal land management agencies: the Bureau of Land Management, the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service and the National Park Service.

Those policies guide how agencies manage millions of acres of wilderness-quality lands. These lands are essential habitats for wildlife and provide recreational opportunities for people looking to explore and enjoy our natural bounty.

But this ongoing review could change how wildlands are managed. If existing policies are weakened, some of our most intact wildlife habitats across national parks, national wildlife refuges and public lands will be vulnerable to development and degradation.

The comment periods for these agency reviews are now open. We only have a short time to speak up and keep our wild places protected for the benefit of all Americans and our wildlife!

SEND A MESSAGE TODAY! (https://support.defenders.org/s/5844478/38SyG9Xl)

Defender, this sweeping review by the Department of the Interior follows a broader pattern of recent rollbacks to public land protections at the highest levels.

We must speak out against giving away our precious wild places to industrial developers at the cost of wildlife and the habitats they depend on for survival.

Before the comment period closes, make your voice heard. Click here to send a message saying you want wilderness-quality lands to remain protected! (https://support.defenders.org/s/5844479/38SyG9Xl)

Defender, thank you for taking action to protect America’s natural legacy.

Sincerely,

Vera Smith

Director National Forests & Public Lands

Defenders of Wildlife

(http://www.facebook.com/DefendersofWildlife) (http://twitter.com/defenders) (https://www.instagram.com/defendersofwildlife/?hl=en) (http://www.youtube.com/defendersofwildlife) (https://www.tiktok.com/@defendersofwildlife)

Defenders of Wildlife 1130 17th Street NW • Washington, DC 20036 defenders.org (https://defenders.org)

But MAGA Republicans across the country haven’t gotten the memo. Instead of addressing the rising cost of living or the challenges facing their communities today, they’re campaigning on debunked conspiracy theories about elections that were decided years ago. Republicans are still obsessing over elections they lost. EMILYs List women are focused on delivering for the people they serve. = | = As a leading member of the far-right House Freedom Caucus, Rep. Andy Biggs has spent years advancing the MAGA agenda and feeding Donald Trump’s election lies. He voted against certifying Arizona’s 2020 presidential election results in Congress — and now, as the Republican nominee for governor, he refuses to say whether Gov. Katie Hobbs legitimately won her election in 2022. In Michigan, John James’ campaign for governor has grown more radical and out of touch by the week. After refusing for weeks to concede his own 2020 U.S. Senate loss, James is now falsely claiming that Trump won Michigan three times — and attacking fellow Republicans for acknowledging that Trump lost the state in 2020. And in Georgia, MAGA megadonor Rick Jackson is pouring an unprecedented amount of money into his campaign for governor. After insisting that the 2020 election was stolen and running attacks against Georgia Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger in the primary for refusing to help Trump overturn the state’s election results, Jackson is launching an unprecedented $87 million advertising blitz to try and buy this seat. If these Republicans still can’t tell the truth about elections that happened years ago, how can voters trust them to protect democracy today? Hey friends,
Episode 5 of _Standing Tall_ is here, and I can't wait for you to hear this one.
**Grammy-winning musician, activist, and all-around force Allison Russell** joined me for a conversation about what happens when art and advocacy become impossible to separate.
[****](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=08ef345bf32fd78090e04097b&id=984b880252&e=dc5f639d62)

[**[Click Here: LISTEN NOW]**](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=08ef345bf32fd78090e04097b&id=f6e6fca866&e=dc5f639d62)
Allison Russell and I talk about the incredible story behind “[Love Rising](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=08ef345bf32fd78090e04097b&id=1952d03bc0&e=dc5f639d62)”—the star-studded benefit concert she helped organize in less than two weeks after Tennessee lawmakers [targeted](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=08ef345bf32fd78090e04097b&id=93785e496f&e=dc5f639d62) the LGBTQ+ community. What started as a rapid response became an arena-sized outpouring of support and pride, with Allison Russell and her fellow artists raising nearly $600,000 for Tennessee LGBTQ+ organizations.
We also talk about her advocacy following the Covenant School shooting, the power of empathy and chosen family, and the growing loss of farmland and the impact of AI data centers on Black communities. And of course, we get into the inspiration for Allison’s powerful new album, [_In the Hour of Chaos_](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=08ef345bf32fd78090e04097b&id=e3f320fda1&e=dc5f639d62) _,_ out now!

Along with choosing local, state, and federal candidates, voters will also decide on several consequential statewide amendments. Here is how the amendments will appear on the ballot:
**Constitutional Amendment No. 1**
Shall Missouri continue for 10 years the one-tenth of one percent sales/use tax that is used for soil and water conservation and for state parks and historic sites, and resubmit this tax to the voters for approval in 10 years? **Constitutional Amendment No. 2**
Shall the Missouri Constitution be amended to:
* Require all charter counties, including Jackson County, to provide for the election of a county assessor; and
* Require assessors in all charter counties to comply with any training requirements established by general law?

**Constitutional Amendment No. 4**
Shall the Missouri Constitution be amended to:
* Modify current requirements that a statewide majority of voters may approve initiative petitions to amend the constitution;
* Require a majority of voters in each congressional district to approve initiative petitions to amend the constitution; and
* Make available to each voter the full text of initiative petitions with their ballot?

The Department of Corrections estimates increased annual costs of up to $21,817. The Office of State Public Defender estimates an unknown fiscal impact. Other state governmental entities estimate no costs or savings. Local governmental entities estimate no costs or savings. **Constitutional Amendment No. 5**
Shall the Missouri Constitution be amended to:
* Require legislative phase-out of the individual state income tax based on revenue growth, and authorize the expansion of sales and use taxes;
* Curtail constitutional limits on taxing goods and services; and
* Require local tax rate cuts without reducing school funding if local sales tax revenue increases?

**About Steve Roberts**
Senator Steven Roberts, a fourth-generation St. Louis native, was sworn into office on January 6, 2021, to represent Missouri’s 5th Senatorial District and was selected as the Democratic Whip for the Minority Caucus. Previously, he served in the Missouri House of Representatives from 2017 to 2020 and chaired the Missouri Legislative Black Caucus. A graduate of the University of Miami and Pepperdine Law, he has worked in Congress, as a prosecutor in St. Louis, and as a Captain in the Missouri Air National Guard’s JAG Corps. He also manages Roberts Law, LLC, and remains active in Missouri’s legal and civic communities.

# Highest Priority: Sweeping Election Integrity Reform
---
My Fellow Texans,
I encourage you to consider that "Sweeping Election Integrity Reform" is our highest and most important priority. Consider Florida and the results once sweeping Election Integrity Reform was passed by their state legislators: ALL COUNTIES, less 2, flipped RED Here we sit in a Texas with 254 Counties whereby population concentrations in the big urban counties are extraordinarily swollen, many times with non-native Texas not reflecting our historical conservative values. Florida was facing the same level of infiltration corruption with miserable results. There are several key elements the business owners, top business executives and credentialed professionals of Texas ask for you to consider: 1) The Secretary of State that certifies the vote of each county MUST be elected by the people of Texas reporting only to the tax paying citizen voters like any other statewide elected official. 2) Election Fraud MUST be vigorously and zealously prosecuted by the State Attorney General's Office with Citizen Oversight in each County and the penalty must result in the banning of any convicted voting fraud from every possible benefit of being a citizen of Texas for life. Theft of vote is muzzling the voice and will of the people and a sentence of life in prison, hard labor and public notice of election fraudsters is our only reasonable choice in a civil society. All else is chaos. 3) The Secretary of State MUST keep a separate "check point" electronic and tokenized secure copy of each ballot cast whereby each voter sets the PIN code to verify his/her legal ballot is cast correctly in the SOS system. Each county may NOT certify an election that does not perfectly match that system. In this way, our individual votes will be kept private and our vote will be 3rd party validated instantly. 4) Mail in Ballot fraud at present has no audit trail and ballots are NOT tracked and traced when they are "re-voted" at the County Election Centers allowing for wholesale ballot manufacturing. This is the source of the Election Fraud Investigation opened by Texas State Attorney General Ken Paxton's office in March of 2026. No chain of custody from the US Postal Service exists for Texas Mail in Ballots. This mail in ballot situation must be standardized, auditable and a clear transparent system that submits entirely to item 3 above. 5) Voter rolls must be purged of voters MONTHLY that no longer meet the test of valid voters residing in the county at the address on file validated by the US Postal Registration Database. Harris County Texas alone has not cleansed its database of voters in years with over 600,000 illegal voters still on its rolls from which ballots are manufactured to throw elections as alleged by the people's lawsuit before Texas Supreme Court as we speak. County Officials that do NOT purge the voter database are NOT prosecuted and this much change at once. They must serve prison time for NOT securing our voter registration database. This must NOT be outsourced to foreign owned entities and must be done locally by the citizens of each county. 6) Open Primaries are a source of weakening our Republican Party Values as candidates are inserted into our elections not reflecting our RPT chosen agenda and crossover primary voting tragically disfigures our Primary Elections. At the same time, our primary elections in big blue counties are often entirely run by Democrat Election Centers. **This is insane.** We must control our brand and hold it entirely accountable to our RPT values elected by our members at Convention. NO election fraud can withstand such vigorous and strategic integrity measures. We encourage you to make election integrity job 1 so the people can believe in our elections.
---
**God Bless you and protect you all,** **JL Trahan** **BIZPAC.us Founder and Executive Chairman**

# Iran
* **Fire, explosions reported at U.S. base in Kuwait:** A large fire [broke out](https://substack.com/redirect/5b092dba-72b5-4b00-9f87-27b33ec6b060?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at a U.S. base in Kuwait on Monday evening,**** where several explosions were heard, Iranian outlets reported, though no casualties or damage were reported.
* **Cargo vessel hit near Oman:** A cargo vessel was [struck](https://substack.com/redirect/747ca221-047b-4a95-a24b-4847915ec336?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by an unidentified projectile near Oman on Monday, the UKMTO reported.
* No details about casualties, damage to the ship, or the identity of the vessel were given in the warning.
* **Trump maintains Iran wants talks with U.S.:** President Donald Trump [accused](https://substack.com/redirect/86c80a6f-4087-420a-966f-f60f7d1cb338?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Iran on Monday of secretly seeking talks despite their public denials of Trump's statements.
* He also claimed that the U.S. currently controls the Strait of Hormuz through a naval blockade, and said that either a "deal" or "total surrender" would end its naval siege.
* Later on Monday, addressing reporters in the White House, Trump [said](https://substack.com/redirect/f895bb38-3adc-4da9-8aae-a0ff68ae8928?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) negotiations were "going on right now," and claimed that Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, and "many others" were involved in the talks. He called the talks "the last chance to sign a good document," and threatened Iran with "decapitation" if an agreement is not reached.
* After noting that the talks were "not very complex" and would "go quickly," Trump [claimed](https://substack.com/redirect/8675a2aa-0d49-4807-b35d-bcd570c403cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that Hormuz could be reopened by "tomorrow" and that during a "phase 2" they would discuss "nuclear capacity." "That will take a little while," he said. His remarks were echoed by U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, who said Tuesday a deal to reopen the strait could be reached "today or tomorrow."
* Qatar said Tuesday that efforts to reach a diplomatic solution between the United States and Iran are continuing, but stressed that no direct talks are currently scheduled. The foreign ministry spokesperson said mediators are working with "all parties" on a "short-term solution" to revive negotiations.
* Trump [accused](https://substack.com/redirect/22b8393f-4e8a-403b-9a33-bd222738bc39?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Chevron and Exxon Mobil of price gouging, saying they made "too much money" during the U.S.'s war on Iran and demanding that both companies cut prices and return gains to consumers.
* **U.S. military crowdsourcing "creative" ways to punish Iran: **U.S. Central Command [emailed](https://substack.com/redirect/7dcf4c29-e966-468b-a06d-57da70593836?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a broad group of military intelligence analysts seeking "creative and unconventional" ways to pressure and punish Iran as Washington reassesses a strategy that has failed to force Tehran into a deal, CNN reported on Monday.
* The "crowdsourcing" comes from Trump's limited paths to victory, the outlet reported, with U.S. intelligence agencies believing that airstrikes alone are unlikely to change Iran's position, and that destroying deeply buried nuclear sites could require Trump to deploy ground troops.
* **Reuters: U.S. has used up "virtually all" its long-range precision missiles:** The U.S. military has used up most of its stockpiles of highly accurate long-range missiles in its war with Iran, [according](https://substack.com/redirect/4461caaf-a900-4acd-8486-2c4e4778d893?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to Reuters. The missiles are primarily surface-to-surface weapons, known as Army Tactical Missile Systems (ATACMS) and Precision Strike Missiles (PrSM), which cost over $1 million each. The U.S. has used "virtually all" of these weapons, two sources familiar with the data told Reuters.

* **Ships continue to move through Hormuz:** Roughly 5 million barrels per day [are moving](https://substack.com/redirect/c8880006-7626-4c4b-9d60-ab2610b3050d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) through the Strait of Hormuz via "dark" ship-to-ship transfers in the Gulf of Oman, according to estimates from Bloomberg.
* Brent crude settled Monday at $83.77 a barrel, down sharply from above $100 on July 23, as fears of a wider supply disruption haveappeared to ease.
* Preliminary data released on Monday indicated that the US Strategic Petroleum Reserve fell by another 2.9 million barrels last week. That is substantially slower than several weekly draws of roughly 7 million to 9 million barrels earlier in the planned 172 million emergency release.

# Yemen
* **Saudi ships avoid Bab Al-Mandab:** Six Saudi-flagged tankers were [detected](https://substack.com/redirect/a5c5b58d-335b-4d58-9890-0e37b6c1c8b1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Monday evening rerouting around the Cape of Good Hope rather than transiting the Red Sea, as shipping adjusts to Ansarallah's maritime blockade targeting Saudi-linked vessels.
* The diversion adds an estimated two to four weeks to voyages and increases transport costs.
* **Ansarallah claims drone strike on Saudi airport:** Ansarallah said it carried out a drone strike on a "sensitive" Saudi target at Najran Airport, claiming the attack achieved a "precise hit." In a [statement](https://substack.com/redirect/62497c6a-2d22-4d64-83bb-37e5c8508643?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Tuesday, the group said the strike was in response to alleged Saudi drone incursions into Yemeni airspace over the governorates of Saada and Hajjah, warning that "any violation of our airspace will not go unanswered or unpunished."

# Palestine
* **Killed and wounded in Gaza:** Over the past 24 hours, two Palestinians were killed and 10 were injured in Israeli attacks across Gaza, according to the Palestinian Ministry of Health.
* The total recorded death toll since October 7, 2023 has risen to 73,377 killed, with 174,230 injured. Since October 11, the first full day of the so-called ceasefire, Israel has killed at least 1,252 Palestinians in Gaza and wounded 4,120, while 804 bodies have been recovered from under the rubble.
* **Israel resumes attacks on Gaza:** Israeli strikes [resumed](https://substack.com/redirect/112419ff-ca62-4cb9-9d64-cff7747494ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Gaza on Monday evening, after a 30 hour pause.
* An Israeli aircraft struck a vehicle on Gaza City's coastal Rashid Street, killing at least two Palestinians and wounding several others.
* Eyad Amawi, Gaza's relief coordinator, told Drop Site the strike came immediately after a "Board of Peace" delegation concluded its visit to Israel.
* **Israeli forces demolish a school, bulldoze land as settlers attack West Bank communities:**
* **Bethlehem:** Israeli forces [bulldozed](https://substack.com/redirect/ff01bf73-50cf-4525-92f6-16ca898da2e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Palestinian agricultural land in the village of Beit Iskaria on Tuesday, in what local officials said was an effort to expand the Gush Etzion settlement bloc, WAFA reported. The attack also damaged the village's drinking water network.
* **Hebron:** Israeli forces [demolished](https://substack.com/redirect/fac39891-fec8-4061-ba0d-d9d92e63bd1f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) two classrooms and a sanitary unit at Shaab Al-Batm Mixed Basic School in Masafer Yatta.
* **Nablus:** Israeli settlers [attacked](https://substack.com/redirect/e415acc7-ff22-46fe-9583-30b914bbf0ca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) communities south of Nablus, setting fire to three vehicles between the villages of Jalud and Talfit and attempting to torch a building before residents intervened.
* **Tulkarm:** Israeli forces [raided](https://substack.com/redirect/c911582e-00eb-4e57-9a06-2d6c232120af?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the home of Wall and Settlement Resistance Commission head Moayad Shaaban in the Dhnaba suburb, interrogated, and threatened that if he continued to call for the formation of popular protection committees, they would raid his home again.
* **East Jerusalem:** Israeli authorities [demolished](https://substack.com/redirect/baf7637e-b7ab-4aa5-8b36-e505add65154?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) properties in the neighborhood of Al-Tur after the owners had previously carried out self-demolitions under Israeli pressure. During the operation, Israeli forces assaulted property owners and other residents, seriously injuring one man in the eye.

* **More than 100 bodies recovered from 2023 Israeli strike laid to rest in Gaza:** Palestinians held a mass funeral Tuesday for 112 bodies recovered over the weekend from the site of a November 2023 Israeli airstrike in Gaza City's Sabra neighborhood, one of the deadliest attacks of the war. Gaza's Civil Defense said the remains included 40 children, while 157 bodies are still believed to be trapped beneath the rubble of the strike, which killed more than 300 people.
* **Qatar, Egypt, and Turkey issue condemnation of Israeli ceasefire violations:** After 4,059 Israeli ceasefire violations [documented](https://substack.com/redirect/f73440aa-6202-421f-864a-8abe0544d350?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by the Palestinian side, the mediators of the Gaza ceasefire--Qatar, Egypt, and Turkey--issued their first joint condemnation of Israel's continuing attacks on Gaza on Monday.
* The three countries condemned Israel's targeting of healthcare facilities and medical infrastructure, and the killing of civilians, including women and children, calling the attacks "a flagrant violation of international law and international humanitarian law."
* A Qatari Foreign Ministry spokesperson told reporters Tuesday that "it is clear to the international community who is obstructing the implementation of the agreement," and that the recent intensification of Israeli strikes was an attempt by Israel to "obstruct peaceful solutions" to the conflict.

* **BoP claims Israel is set to withdraw only after Hamas disarms, contradicting its own roadmap:** The U.S.-led "Board of Peace" put out a statement on Monday after a meeting between its envoy, Nickolay Mladenov, and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, saying that Israeli withdrawal from Gaza would come only after Hamas fully disarms.
* The statement said that Israeli forces would withdraw "beyond the Yellow Line...once decommissioning is complete," and that this applied to "light weapons, heavy weapons, and the tunnels alike."
* A roadmap previously published by the board, however, said that the disarmament process would begin only after a phased Israeli withdrawal from the Strip, as well as the decommissioning of Israeli-backed militias. The roadmap also limited disarmament to "heavy weapons, military production sites, depots of weapons, and tunnels," but did not include "light weapons."
* Separately, documents leaked on Monday showed that the BoP is advancing plans for more than 60 infrastructure, economic, and "security" projects across the Gaza Strip, scheduled to launch between August 2026 and January 2027, according to Israel's public broadcaster Kan.
* Kan also reported that the board [pledged](https://substack.com/redirect/4185fadb-f97b-42ca-8342-483711941f9d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to Israel that it would seek countries to receive students and patients from Gaza, in exchange for Israel dropping its displacement plan. Israel had recently renamed the forced displacement plan a "freedom of movement" plan, in an effort to make it more acceptable to foreign governments.

* **Hamas official discusses arms policy:** During a Monday evening appearance on Piers Morgan Live, Ghazi Hamad, a senior Hamas official, [said](https://substack.com/redirect/85cb298b-25d9-442d-ba75-bf08cc1cf3f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that Hamas' planned decommissioning of weapons was an "exceptional phase" accepted out of necessity, and that the group has not changed its goal of ending Israel's occupation of the Strip, to which it might employ "different techniques, different tools, different methods."
* **Israel detained 630 Palestinians in West Bank during July, prisoner group says:** These detentions across the occupied West Bank, including East Jerusalem, brought the total number of arrests since the start of the Gaza war to more than 25,000, according to the Palestinian Prisoner's Society.
* More than 9,400 Palestinians are currently held in Israeli prisons, including around 370 children, 92 women, and 3,198 administrative detainees, held without charge.

* **Al-Hayya talks with Turkish, Iranian leaders:** Hamas political chief Khalil Al-Hayya [met](https://substack.com/redirect/504f8b51-c5fd-4cfb-983b-7c3bfece6033?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Turkish intelligence chief Ibrahim Kalın on Monday to discuss Gaza ceasefire negotiations, Israel's ongoing attacks, and developments in the occupied West Bank and Jerusalem, Shehab News reported.
* Hamas said Kalın praised the movement and the Palestinian factions' position in the negotiations, called for implementation of what was agreed, and said Turkey would continue supporting Palestinians' right to live with dignity.
* Al-Hayya also [held](https://substack.com/redirect/c9cb7f09-2f58-464b-a796-fc5052ff77ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a phone call with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian. Pezeshkian told Al-Hayya that Iran "stands with [Hamas] and supports [it] in all the measures you take," according to a Hamas readout, despite the ongoing U.S. attacks on Iran.

# Lebanon
* **Lebanon and Israel resume talks in Rome:** Lebanon and Israel began a seventh round of U.S.-brokered direct talks in Rome on Tuesday amid the ongoing Israeli occupation of southern Lebanon and violations of the ceasefire. The three-day talks will focus on advancing the framework agreement reached in June that Hezbollah was not a party to.
* Hezbollah Secretary-General Naim Qassem [accused](https://substack.com/redirect/b3e7da53-d88c-4337-895a-29f97552f882?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Lebanon's political leadership of having "been a help to Israel instead of a help to Lebanon's sovereignty," saying it had offered "free concessions" while Israel "took everything," Lebanon's National News Agency reported. He urged Lebanese authorities to "stop the free concessions," open dialogue with Hezbollah, and work to secure an Israeli withdrawal.
* Prime Minister Nawaf Salam [rejected](https://substack.com/redirect/bfd6cab6-8820-48cd-9dda-8d59624f1229?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Qassem's remarks, saying "the greatest help to Israel was provided by those who unilaterally dragged Lebanon into futile 'support' wars," giving Israel "the pretexts" to attack the country. He said there can be "no sovereignty for Lebanon except through one independent decision in a state with one army" and argued that dialogue requires "the courage to acknowledge the facts."

# U.S. News
* **At long last, the Michigan primary:** Polls close throughout most of Michigan at 8 p.m. ET today, and results in the closely watched race between **Abdul El-Sayed** and Rep.**Haley Stevens** will be coming in quickly. In Missouri, **Cori Bush** is locked in a rematch with Rep. **Wesley Bell,** who knocked her out of Congress with a then-record-setting amount of money from AIPAC.
* At 7:30 pm ET, **Ryan Grim** is going live with **Krystal Ball** on both the Drop Site and Breaking Points YouTube pages, and we'll track the results of critical races in Michigan, Washington, Missouri, and Virginia.
* A key list of races we're watching in Michigan, where over a dozen anti-establishment candidates are hoping to sweep, **[is available here](https://substack.com/redirect/be77317a-0490-4654-975c-32df717a1327?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**.
* **Immigrant dies at Newark ICE facility** : **Edwin Lopez-Cornejo** , a 41-year-old Salvadoran immigrant, [died](https://substack.com/redirect/c0a40aaa-ed5a-4142-91e3-92e17db5953f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Saturday at University Hospital in Newark after a medical emergency at the Delaney Hall detention center, federal officials confirmed Monday, marking the second death at the facility in eight months.
* Lopez-Cornejo's mother, **Maria Cornejo** , said her son, who had been prescribed medication for diabetes, told her Friday that he had lost feeling in his face and hand.
* **DOJ increasingly uses Civil War-era conspiracy law to charge ICE protesters, NPR finds** : The Justice Department has [charged](https://substack.com/redirect/159ea0de-400a-42f7-9ff4-861cf5409738?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) more than three dozen people in at least 10 cases since President Donald Trump took office last year under a Civil War-era statute barring conspiracy to impede federal officers, according to an NPR review of court records.
* Those charged under the statute include Minneapolis special education teacher **Treasure Thoreson** , who was arrested in June over alleged blockades outside ICE's Whipple Federal Building headquarters, and three Spokane, Washington protesters convicted in May after being accused of blocking a van transporting detainees, a case that led the district's then-U.S. attorney, **Richard Barker** , to resign rather than sign the indictment.
* **Twenty-five states sue Trump administration over new Section 301 tariffs on 60 economies** : A coalition of 25 states led by California [filed](https://substack.com/redirect/9b2b4d1b-bc27-4744-af1f-a189fb174123?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a lawsuit Monday in the U.S. Court of International Trade, alleging the Trump administration exceeded its authority in imposing tariffs of 10% to 12.5% on 60 economies under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974.
* The states argue that these tariffs are a thinly concealed effort to replace levies struck down by the Supreme Court in February, and that the investigation by the Office of the U.S. Trade Representative that justified the tariffs was rushed, resulting in overly broad hikes.
* This is the third time California has sued the administration over its tariff policy.
* **Federal judge strikes down New York 's ban on masked ICE agents**: U.S. District Judge **Mae A. D 'Agostino** [struck down](https://substack.com/redirect/b9c4210a-9fc5-43f2-a226-720a66c1a3ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) New York's law barring federal officers from wearing masks, ruling Monday that the Constitution's Supremacy Clause bars the state from regulating federal law enforcement activities, while upholding a separate New York law that prohibits local and state police from cooperating with ICE through 287(g) agreements.
* The Trump administration has successfully challenged similar mask bans in California and is contesting related laws in Connecticut, New Jersey, Virginia, and Philadelphia.
* **FCC commissioners receive luxury gifts from Paramount ahead of merger:** FCC Chair **Brendan Carr** and Commissioner **Olivia Trusty** [accepted](https://substack.com/redirect/6ec478fc-df63-4f41-b3d2-be7ebeaf3caa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) luxury Kennedy Center honors gala tickets from Paramount, with Carr's accepting gifts from CBS or its parent company worth over $75,000 since he took office in 2017 and watching the 2025 Gala in Ellison's private skybox, ProPublica reports.
* Two complaints by watchdog groups demand investigations into whether they violated federal gift rules and ask that Carr be disqualified from the commission's pending decision on the Paramount-Warner Bros. Discovery merger.
* Both Carr and Trusty previously voted to approve Paramount's merger with Skydance, which Carr claimed "advanced the public interest."
* **AIPAC moves into the California special election:** Pro-Israel money is pouring into **Eric Swalwell** 's old district, trying to lift **Melissa Hernandez** over **Aisha Wahab** , using all these same tired vehicles to cloak the money Through United Democracy Project, AIPAC is [now actively spending](https://substack.com/redirect/b615ff1b-bf39-4511-bdc9-839d8f796d6d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in California's 14th district., with a minimum $600k booked. The special election to replace Swalwell is on August 18.

# Other International News
* **DRC Ebola death toll surpasses 1,700 as WHO accelerates vaccine, treatment trials** : The death toll from the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak has [risen](https://substack.com/redirect/0ba03f9a-9371-43a5-b550-bb2d2dd929a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to 1,707 out of 3,802 recorded cases since it was declared May 15, making it the second-largest and fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record.
* The World Health Organization said that trials of experimental treatments and vaccines for the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no approved medicines, are advancing faster than in past outbreaks due to years of advance planning.
* The response to the outbreak has been hampered by armed group violence, attacks on health facilities, and a funding shortfall, with more than 100 healthcare workers infected and staff in some areas striking over unpaid wages.
* **More than 150 migrants rescued from English Channel after boat fire** : More than 150 migrants were [rescued](https://substack.com/redirect/ae8e8490-f5a4-48dd-bffa-9d3696c478a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Tuesday after their boat caught fire while crossing the English Channel from France, according to Al Jazeera.
* More than 2,000 people have crossed the Channel in small boats since Andy Burnham became UK prime minister two weeks ago. Burnham pledged that he will be "relentless" in stopping the crossings.
* **Russian, Ukrainian attacks kill at least 27:** At least 16 people were [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/5381362f-1547-4b56-bd0c-1999d35fc8e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Russia and 11 in Ukraine as the two countries continued exchanging attacks Monday and Tuesday, according to local officials on each side, Al Jazeera reported.
* In Russia's Krasnodar region, a Ukrainian drone strike killed seven people, including three children, in Arkhipo-Osipovka, and wounded 40 others.
* A Ukrainian drone strike in the border region of Belgorod killed four people, and a separate attack on Moscow killed five.
* Ukrainian strikes in Russian-occupied Crimea killed four people.
* In Ukraine, a Russian attack on a petrol station in the Dnipropetrovsk killed three, including an emergency worker and his eight-year-old son.
* A separate Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia killed eight people, including two children.
* **Sudan 's army vows to defeat the RSF by year's end: **Sudanese army chief of staff Yasser al-Atta [said](https://substack.com/redirect/45476341-0fc4-4fda-99a2-d3cb9fddd1ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the military (SAF) is advancing on all fronts and aims to eliminate the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) before the end of the year, Anadolu reported on Monday.
* "Before the end of this year, there will not be a single Janjaweed fighter" or "foreign fighter," al-Atta told a gathering of soldiers, al-Atta said, referring to the RSF's antecedent group and the group responsible for the nearly two-decade long genocide in Darfur.
* Al-Atta claimed that the SAF was "advancing in all directions... as happened during the recapture of Khartoum state."
* His remarks followed what the army said was a rapid operation to seize Bara and other positions along the road linking Omdurman with El-Obeid in North Kordofan.
* The Kordofan region has seen continued SAF-RSF fighting since October 2025, when the RSF seized the Darfur capital of El-Fasher.
* **Cross-border shelling kills dozens of refugees near the Sudan-Ethiopia border:** Deadly shelling triggered by renewed fighting between Ethiopian federal troops and Tigray regional forces [struck](https://substack.com/redirect/da81ce71-9097-4ee3-a26c-be264d56cb34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) refugee camps along the Sudan-Ethiopia border, according to a statement Monday by Sudan's Interior Ministry.
* The ministry said the confrontations, which started over the weekend, caused artillery to land directly within refugee settlements, resulting in multiple fatalities and injuries.
* Officials did not release an exact death toll, but a Red Cross official in Sudan, Abel Binyam, told Drop Site's Godfrey Olukya that he saw "over 50" dead bodies.
* The clashes, near Shererina in western Tigray, were the second major outbreak between the two sides since the 2022 African Union-mediated peace pact signed in South Africa. Both accused the other of starting the fighting, which had largely subsided by Sunday. Hundreds of Tigrayans, including wounded fighters, have fled into Sudan, and Tigray's leadership has urged its people to prepare "to fight for Tigray's national survival."
* **China accuses Philippines of "political provocation" over cultural programs:** The Chinese government [accused](https://substack.com/redirect/1663baec-8b3c-4a76-811a-2506c2a5eba6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the Philippines of an "extremely serious political provocation" after the Philippine Defense Department called for greater oversight of foreign state-backed academic and cultural exchange programs, citing Chinese laws requiring citizens and organizations to cooperate with state intelligence agencies.
* China's Foreign Ministry called the concerns "lies and malicious attacks," accusing unnamed "anti-China forces" of using the issue to distract from Philippine naval actions in the South China Sea.

This is Drop Site Daily, our free news recap We send it Monday - Friday Iran Fire, explosions reported at U.S. base in Kuwait: A large fire at a U.S. base in Kuwait on Monday evening,** where several explosions were heard, Iranian outlets reported, though no casualties or damage were reported. Cargo vessel hit near Oman: A cargo vessel was by an unidentified projectile near Oman on Monday, the UKMTO reported. No details about casualties, damage to the ship, or the identity of the vessel were given in the warning. Trump maintains Iran wants talks with U.S.: President Donald Trump Iran on Monday of secretly seeking talks despite their public denials of Trump's statements. He also claimed that the U.S. currently controls the Strait of Hormuz through a naval blockade, and said that either a "deal" or "total surrender" would end its naval siege. Later on Monday, addressing reporters in the White House, Trump negotiations were "going on right now," and claimed that Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, and "many others" were involved in the talks. He called the talks "the last chance to sign a good document," and threatened Iran with "decapitation" if an agreement is not reached. After noting that the talks were "not very complex" and would "go quickly," Trump that Hormuz could be reopened by "tomorrow" and that during a "phase 2" they would discuss "nuclear capacity." "That will take a little while," he said. His remarks were echoed by U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, who said Tuesday a deal to reopen the strait could be reached "today or tomorrow." Qatar said Tuesday that efforts to reach a diplomatic solution between the United States and Iran are continuing, but stressed that no direct talks are currently scheduled. The foreign ministry spokesperson said mediators are working with "all parties" on a "short-term solution" to revive negotiations. Trump Chevron and Exxon Mobil of price gouging, saying they made "too much money" during the U.S.'s war on Iran and demanding that both companies cut prices and return gains to consumers. U.S. military crowdsourcing "creative" ways to punish Iran: U.S. Central Command a broad group of military intelligence analysts seeking "creative and unconventional" ways to pressure and punish Iran as Washington reassesses a strategy that has failed to force Tehran into a deal, CNN reported on Monday. The "crowdsourcing" comes from Trump's limited paths to victory, the outlet reported, with U.S. intelligence agencies believing that airstrikes alone are unlikely to change Iran's position, and that destroying deeply buried nuclear sites could require Trump to deploy ground troops. Reuters: U.S. has used up "virtually all" its long-range precision missiles: The U.S. military has used up most of its stockpiles of highly accurate long-range missiles in its war with Iran, to Reuters. The missiles are primarily surface-to-surface weapons, known as Army Tactical Missile Systems (ATACMS) and Precision Strike Missiles (PrSM), which cost over $1 million each. The U.S. has used "virtually all" of these weapons, two sources familiar with the data told Reuters. Ships continue to move through Hormuz: Roughly 5 million barrels per day through the Strait of Hormuz via "dark" ship-to-ship transfers in the Gulf of Oman, according to estimates from Bloomberg. Brent crude settled Monday at $83.77 a barrel, down sharply from above $100 on July 23, as fears of a wider supply disruption haveappeared to ease. Preliminary data released on Monday indicated that the US Strategic Petroleum Reserve fell by another 2.9 million barrels last week. That is substantially slower than several weekly draws of roughly 7 million to 9 million barrels earlier in the planned 172 million emergency release. Yemen Saudi ships avoid Bab Al-Mandab: Six Saudi-flagged tankers were on Monday evening rerouting around the Cape of Good Hope rather than transiting the Red Sea, as shipping adjusts to Ansarallah's maritime blockade targeting Saudi-linked vessels. The diversion adds an estimated two to four weeks to voyages and increases transport costs. Ansarallah claims drone strike on Saudi airport: Ansarallah said it carried out a drone strike on a "sensitive" Saudi target at Najran Airport, claiming the attack achieved a "precise hit." In a Tuesday, the group said the strike was in response to alleged Saudi drone incursions into Yemeni airspace over the governorates of Saada and Hajjah, warning that "any violation of our airspace will not go unanswered or unpunished." Palestine Killed and wounded in Gaza: Over the past 24 hours, two Palestinians were killed and 10 were injured in Israeli attacks across Gaza, according to the Palestinian Ministry of Health. The total recorded death toll since October 7, 2023 has risen to 73,377 killed, with 174,230 injured. Since October 11, the first full day of the so-called ceasefire, Israel has killed at least 1,252 Palestinians in Gaza and wounded 4,120, while 804 bodies have been recovered from under the rubble. Israel resumes attacks on Gaza: Israeli strikes in Gaza on Monday evening, after a 30 hour pause. An Israeli aircraft struck a vehicle on Gaza City's coastal Rashid Street, killing at least two Palestinians and wounding several others. Eyad Amawi, Gaza's relief coordinator, told Drop Site the strike came immediately after a "Board of Peace" delegation concluded its visit to Israel. Israeli forces demolish a school, bulldoze land as settlers attack West Bank communities: Bethlehem: Israeli forces Palestinian agricultural land in the village of Beit Iskaria on Tuesday, in what local officials said was an effort to expand the Gush Etzion settlement bloc, WAFA reported. The attack also damaged the village's drinking water network. Hebron: Israeli forces two classrooms and a sanitary unit at Shaab Al-Batm Mixed Basic School in Masafer Yatta. Nablus: Israeli settlers communities south of Nablus, setting fire to three vehicles between the villages of Jalud and Talfit and attempting to torch a building before residents intervened. Tulkarm: Israeli forces the home of Wall and Settlement Resistance Commission head Moayad Shaaban in the Dhnaba suburb, interrogated, and threatened that if he continued to call for the formation of popular protection committees, they would raid his home again. East Jerusalem: Israeli authorities properties in the neighborhood of Al-Tur after the owners had previously carried out self-demolitions under Israeli pressure. During the operation, Israeli forces assaulted property owners and other residents, seriously injuring one man in the eye. More than 100 bodies recovered from 2023 Israeli strike laid to rest in Gaza: Palestinians held a mass funeral Tuesday for 112 bodies recovered over the weekend from the site of a November 2023 Israeli airstrike in Gaza City's Sabra neighborhood, one of the deadliest attacks of the war. Gaza's Civil Defense said the remains included 40 children, while 157 bodies are still believed to be trapped beneath the rubble of the strike, which killed more than 300 people. Qatar, Egypt, and Turkey issue condemnation of Israeli ceasefire violations: After 4,059 Israeli ceasefire violations by the Palestinian side, the mediators of the Gaza ceasefire--Qatar, Egypt, and Turkey--issued their first joint condemnation of Israel's continuing attacks on Gaza on Monday. The three countries condemned Israel's targeting of healthcare facilities and medical infrastructure, and the killing of civilians, including women and children, calling the attacks "a flagrant violation of international law and international humanitarian law." A Qatari Foreign Ministry spokesperson told reporters Tuesday that "it is clear to the international community who is obstructing the implementation of the agreement," and that the recent intensification of Israeli strikes was an attempt by Israel to "obstruct peaceful solutions" to the conflict. BoP claims Israel is set to withdraw only after Hamas disarms, contradicting its own roadmap: The U.S.-led "Board of Peace" put out a statement on Monday after a meeting between its envoy, Nickolay Mladenov, and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, saying that Israeli withdrawal from Gaza would come only after Hamas fully disarms. The statement said that Israeli forces would withdraw "beyond the Yellow Line...once decommissioning is complete," and that this applied to "light weapons, heavy weapons, and the tunnels alike." A roadmap previously published by the board, however, said that the disarmament process would begin only after a phased Israeli withdrawal from the Strip, as well as the decommissioning of Israeli-backed militias. The roadmap also limited disarmament to "heavy weapons, military production sites, depots of weapons, and tunnels," but did not include "light weapons." Separately, documents leaked on Monday showed that the BoP is advancing plans for more than 60 infrastructure, economic, and "security" projects across the Gaza Strip, scheduled to launch between August 2026 and January 2027, according to Israel's public broadcaster Kan. Kan also reported that the board to Israel that it would seek countries to receive students and patients from Gaza, in exchange for Israel dropping its displacement plan. Israel had recently renamed the forced displacement plan a "freedom of movement" plan, in an effort to make it more acceptable to foreign governments. Hamas official discusses arms policy: During a Monday evening appearance on Piers Morgan Live, Ghazi Hamad, a senior Hamas official, that Hamas' planned decommissioning of weapons was an "exceptional phase" accepted out of necessity, and that the group has not changed its goal of ending Israel's occupation of the Strip, to which it might employ "different techniques, different tools, different methods." Israel detained 630 Palestinians in West Bank during July, prisoner group says: These detentions across the occupied West Bank, including East Jerusalem, brought the total number of arrests since the start of the Gaza war to more than 25,000, according to the Palestinian Prisoner's Society. More than 9,400 Palestinians are currently held in Israeli prisons, including around 370 children, 92 women, and 3,198 administrative detainees, held without charge. Al-Hayya talks with Turkish, Iranian leaders: Hamas political chief Khalil Al-Hayya Turkish intelligence chief Ibrahim Kalın on Monday to discuss Gaza ceasefire negotiations, Israel's ongoing attacks, and developments in the occupied West Bank and Jerusalem, Shehab News reported. Hamas said Kalın praised the movement and the Palestinian factions' position in the negotiations, called for implementation of what was agreed, and said Turkey would continue supporting Palestinians' right to live with dignity. Al-Hayya also a phone call with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian. Pezeshkian told Al-Hayya that Iran "stands with [Hamas] and supports [it] in all the measures you take," according to a Hamas readout, despite the ongoing U.S. attacks on Iran. Lebanon Lebanon and Israel resume talks in Rome: Lebanon and Israel began a seventh round of U.S.-brokered direct talks in Rome on Tuesday amid the ongoing Israeli occupation of southern Lebanon and violations of the ceasefire. The three-day talks will focus on advancing the framework agreement reached in June that Hezbollah was not a party to. Hezbollah Secretary-General Naim Qassem Lebanon's political leadership of having "been a help to Israel instead of a help to Lebanon's sovereignty," saying it had offered "free concessions" while Israel "took everything," Lebanon's National News Agency reported. He urged Lebanese authorities to "stop the free concessions," open dialogue with Hezbollah, and work to secure an Israeli withdrawal. Prime Minister Nawaf Salam Qassem's remarks, saying "the greatest help to Israel was provided by those who unilaterally dragged Lebanon into futile 'support' wars," giving Israel "the pretexts" to attack the country. He said there can be "no sovereignty for Lebanon except through one independent decision in a state with one army" and argued that dialogue requires "the courage to acknowledge the facts."
