In Missouri, Cori Bush is locked in a rematch with Rep. Wesley Bell, who knocked her out of Congress with a then-record-setting amount of money from AIPAC. At 7:30 pm ET, Ryan Grim is going live with Krystal Ball on both the Drop Site and Breaking Points YouTube pages, and we'll track the results of critical races in Michigan, Washington, Missouri, and Virginia. A key list of races we're watching in Michigan, where over a dozen anti-establishment candidates are hoping to sweep, . Immigrant dies at Newark ICE facility : Edwin Lopez-Cornejo , a 41-year-old Salvadoran immigrant, Saturday at University Hospital in Newark after a medical emergency at the Delaney Hall detention center, federal officials confirmed Monday, marking the second death at the facility in eight months. Lopez-Cornejo's mother, Maria Cornejo , said her son, who had been prescribed medication for diabetes, told her Friday that he had lost feeling in his face and hand. DOJ increasingly uses Civil War-era conspiracy law to charge ICE protesters, NPR finds : The Justice Department has more than three dozen people in at least 10 cases since President Donald Trump took office last year under a Civil War-era statute barring conspiracy to impede federal officers, according to an NPR review of court records. Those charged under the statute include Minneapolis special education teacher Treasure Thoreson , who was arrested in June over alleged blockades outside ICE's Whipple Federal Building headquarters, and three Spokane, Washington protesters convicted in May after being accused of blocking a van transporting detainees, a case that led the district's then-U.S. attorney, Richard Barker , to resign rather than sign the indictment. Twenty-five states sue Trump administration over new Section 301 tariffs on 60 economies : A coalition of 25 states led by California a lawsuit Monday in the U.S. Court of International Trade, alleging the Trump administration exceeded its authority in imposing tariffs of 10% to 12.5% on 60 economies under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974. The states argue that these tariffs are a thinly concealed effort to replace levies struck down by the Supreme Court in February, and that the investigation by the Office of the U.S. Trade Representative that justified the tariffs was rushed, resulting in overly broad hikes. This is the third time California has sued the administration over its tariff policy. Federal judge strikes down New York 's ban on masked ICE agents: U.S. District Judge Mae A. D 'Agostino New York's law barring federal officers from wearing masks, ruling Monday that the Constitution's Supremacy Clause bars the state from regulating federal law enforcement activities, while upholding a separate New York law that prohibits local and state police from cooperating with ICE through 287(g) agreements. The Trump administration has successfully challenged similar mask bans in California and is contesting related laws in Connecticut, New Jersey, Virginia, and Philadelphia. FCC commissioners receive luxury gifts from Paramount ahead of merger: FCC Chair Brendan Carr and Commissioner Olivia Trusty luxury Kennedy Center honors gala tickets from Paramount, with Carr's accepting gifts from CBS or its parent company worth over $75,000 since he took office in 2017 and watching the 2025 Gala in Ellison's private skybox, ProPublica reports. Two complaints by watchdog groups demand investigations into whether they violated federal gift rules and ask that Carr be disqualified from the commission's pending decision on the Paramount-Warner Bros. Discovery merger. Both Carr and Trusty previously voted to approve Paramount's merger with Skydance, which Carr claimed "advanced the public interest." AIPAC moves into the California special election: Pro-Israel money is pouring into Eric Swalwell 's old district, trying to lift Melissa Hernandez over Aisha Wahab , using all these same tired vehicles to cloak the money Through United Democracy Project, AIPAC is in California's 14th district., with a minimum $600k booked. The special election to replace Swalwell is on August 18. 📥 Have a tip on Capitol Hill? The World Health Organization said that trials of experimental treatments and vaccines for the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no approved medicines, are advancing faster than in past outbreaks due to years of advance planning. The response to the outbreak has been hampered by armed group violence, attacks on health facilities, and a funding shortfall, with more than 100 healthcare workers infected and staff in some areas striking over unpaid wages. More than 2,000 people have crossed the Channel in small boats since Andy Burnham became UK prime minister two weeks ago. Burnham pledged that he will be "relentless" in stopping the crossings. The Kordofan region has seen continued SAF-RSF fighting since October 2025, when the RSF seized the Darfur capital of El-Fasher. Cross-border shelling kills dozens of refugees near the Sudan-Ethiopia border: Deadly shelling triggered by renewed fighting between Ethiopian federal troops and Tigray regional forces refugee camps along the Sudan-Ethiopia border, according to a statement Monday by Sudan's Interior Ministry. The ministry said the confrontations, which started over the weekend, caused artillery to land directly within refugee settlements, resulting in multiple fatalities and injuries. Officials did not release an exact death toll, but a Red Cross official in Sudan, Abel Binyam, told Drop Site's Godfrey Olukya that he saw "over 50" dead bodies. The clashes, near Shererina in western Tigray, were the second major outbreak between the two sides since the 2022 African Union-mediated peace pact signed in South Africa. Both accused the other of starting the fighting, which had largely subsided by Sunday. Hundreds of Tigrayans, including wounded fighters, have fled into Sudan, and Tigray's leadership has urged its people to prepare "to fight for Tigray's national survival." China accuses Philippines of "political provocation" over cultural programs: The Chinese government the Philippines of an "extremely serious political provocation" after the Philippine Defense Department called for greater oversight of foreign state-backed academic and cultural exchange programs, citing Chinese laws requiring citizens and organizations to cooperate with state intelligence agencies. name: Roy Cooper
subject: Waiting on my order
body:
All the little expenses that go into running statewide add up real fast.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk849&source=&t=1&akid=2518%2E124072%2E3gUbIk)
| | | |
---
Hey there, Peter – I’m on the campaign trail, stopping for a quick bite with my team, and I thought I’d send you a note while I wait for my meal to arrive.
I’m so grateful for all the support our campaign has received lately, and just as a heads up, we’re going to need a lot more of it as November gets closer and closer. Reaching North Carolinians across the state is no easy – or cheap – feat, and it involves things like:
* ⛽️ Filling up the gas tank
* 🪧 Ordering signs and flyers for local events
* 📍 Opening new field office locations
* ☎️ Hosting phone banks
* 🏘️ Knocking on doors and having face-to-face conversations
* 📺 Launching more TV and digital ads
* 🍔 Feeding my team and grassroots volunteers

Dear Patriot,
Think about the last time you stood in the grocery store and really felt it. The number at the bottom of the receipt keeps climbing, a cart that used to cost eighty dollars somehow costs a hundred and thirty now, and you quietly put something back on the shelf before you reach the register. You do the math in your head the whole drive home. You work hard and you pay your taxes, and still you have to think twice before you can fill your own refrigerator. **[Now let me show you where some of your money is _actually_ going.](https://links.stayinformednow.net/u/click?_t=c02d37b0057e4505a2324dee8ee3dc76&_m=3412d6287fa240789f46e2ff8dbf5c8a&_e=pAcCyPLzczhDnAZZfjTgOqjTVd3EPYJQabTQgBSDYpEWi7qJODySDsQHvGLNtwpK1G6X1AMdmzPrOGDpypjZ_9CdyFZR64IxG1NtHMzmvs4IHzicpyjyy1vcdg6k1UTYOprmJ02x3m-T481vdVjMgW9YGRCQ_HpSROrOBc6KkRalg5SBA0qAcySvM3a3ABSM-unvrmUOWMLjbvkMT6Q9oSlLHPb-nBIBaL6jE1KY5_9f-x9lkGkX3e_Q-VFly6WnM3K7jWT9kF4KULN_Nb51yFAcgT7goXp6cAUTqUYSA4xs0PxSk8X4e02qIO-NBs00xa0cY-WuyyRZ1uP__7kiMdfh2WR4_R-vlmQejlGEIEbTVYsmFmiMf6K5iohzQYYBv5fpImcljN_oQfCC8nNXWyIJbpajfVPrDTR673RtfOoIvu1mAcvxmgIKVRTfY9bLkm8OCGFcFJ2E4IbLRUsdu5iW6u_0CL4c6mjdiiT4Lg3zHhNcHPhvtDLXaW89_oSpbQvp2wnb5aKlzp5jzQz252aHuVezHDFaRj_6xApkzzVw5i41zV0Mwac_X2iiY6AVB-EG7fIYlmNk336LYJW_Qg%3D%3D)** [](https://links.stayinformednow.net/u/click?_t=c02d37b0057e4505a2324dee8ee3dc76&_m=3412d6287fa240789f46e2ff8dbf5c8a&_e=pAcCyPLzczhDnAZZfjTgOqjTVd3EPYJQabTQgBSDYpEWi7qJODySDsQHvGLNtwpK1G6X1AMdmzPrOGDpypjZ_9CdyFZR64IxG1NtHMzmvs4IHzicpyjyy1vcdg6k1UTYOprmJ02x3m-T481vdVjMgW9YGRCQ_HpSROrOBc6KkRalg5SBA0qAcySvM3a3ABSM0fTNRFjl96M_2VhXuDPAueVaA-dtdYXhgywbVHEMN4VNAldjGBC4TtIASUgipT16x2hY5ZCF34eE-laA5P_6Q5G6cALLVuyYD11hs4C5WtItB0NVzs52o49fpEAslCD2RSjHR_48oI-EHX5jycBMYyRLOgfFrbOmlOicf93Selr_CDwxVzMg04rvrUdwzxv6P1bKZhL0FXvr_Q7wgWD3udaAjz2eBOFpZkRnHyrCFt4pSMs5H7pstvJylOIFqxwUSP78fB8SrpO50V8HOF4HsqYZpG8O999RYJyi0YDREZXm6XM_NjsZI1a4T0BWjWJBTkIEerC0d766QzOJpItPMOFDOueQF30RaDmZR8CBFjl0E0WK3UuryFmD6UBQdswAlvs0xIrKkPHM8HTVGiLHbA%3D%3D)
O'Keefe Media Group released the first part of a new undercover investigation. Our team walked into bodegas and smoke shops in New York City wearing hidden cameras. **Greetings, Fellow Alaskans and Friends: **
**Not many candidates for governor can say they grew up enduring the milk run or hauling Costco groceries onto a ferry. I can. My roots are in Southeast Alaska, and that upbringing shaped something that no amount of campaigning can replicate: a bone-deep understanding of what life looks like in every corner of this state, from the Panhandle to the Interior.**** ****That same conviction drives our fight on Alaska lands and Alaska livelihoods. The federal government controls 62% of Alaska while holding less than 1% of New York, and our farmers don't need a bureaucracy hovering over them. As governor, I'll fight to restore federal lands to Alaska hands, open more state land for private ownership, and get government out of the way of the people who feed and build this state. Endorsements from Stand For Health Freedom, rural leader Paulette Schuerch of Kotzebue, and David Gottstein reflect a coalition that stretches from the Panhandle to the Arctic, Alaskans who know this ticket is the people's choice.**** ****August 18th is approaching, early voting is open now, and we have a major announcement dropping this evening (Tuesday). We'll also be on the debate stage in Soldotna on August 6th at the Narrowing the Field forum. Scroll down for details on both, and let's finish strong together.**** ****Ready to serve you,**
---

**Republican Candidate for Governor****of the Great State of Alaska**

The federal government controls 62% of Alaska while holding less than 1% of New York, and our farmers don't need a bureaucracy hovering over them. name: Rep. Vikki Goodwin
subject: I just spoke out against closing polling places.
disclaimer_text: paid for by the Vikki Goodwin Campaign, Allen Biehl, Treasurer
body:
https://act.vikkigoodwin.com/dont-mess-with-texas-voters/ [https://act.vikkigoodwin.com/dont-mess-with-texas-voters/]
Peter,
I just gave a public comment in defense of voting rights at the Tarrant County Commissioners Court.
https://act.vikkigoodwin.com/dont-mess-with-texas-voters/ [https://act.vikkigoodwin.com/dont-mess-with-texas-voters/]
The GOP majority on the court want to close nearly half of their polling places before the midterms to suppress votes. I showed up to fight back, because Texas voters deserve a Lt. Governor who fights for them in every room where their rights are under attack. [https://act.vikkigoodwin.com/dont-mess-with-texas-voters/]
Let me be clear about what’s at stake: Dan Patrick and the GOP are not talking about making elections more efficient. This is just another page from their voter suppression playbook... Tarrant County was the testing ground for redistricting and gerrymandering before it spread across Texas. I fought it back then, and I’m fighting now as they try to close polling places. [https://act.vikkigoodwin.com/dont-mess-with-texas-voters/]
Tarrant is the third largest and most competitive county in Texas. We proved it when Taylor Rehmet won a historic Senate race in January. The GOP knows their days in power are numbered, and they are ready to deny our right to vote if it means they can hang onto power.
Fewer places to vote means longer lines . Longer lines mean fewer votes . And fewer votes from Tarrant County will impact not just local races, but statewide races including Senate, Governor, and my own race.
I am not going to let that happen without a fight, but I need you to stand with me right now. Add your name to support fair elections and tell the GOP that Texas voters will not be silenced. [https://act.vikkigoodwin.com/dont-mess-with-texas-voters/]
SIGN OUR PETITION [https://act.vikkigoodwin.com/dont-mess-with-texas-voters/]
Voter suppression doesn't announce itself. It shows up labeled as "efficiency." It shows up as "cost savings." It impacts all of us, and when nobody pushes back, it becomes law.
That's why I spoke out today, and why I'm writing to you. They will try to stack the odds, but every time Texas voters are underestimated, we prove them wrong.
That's why this race matters — and why we need the resources to keep fighting. Every dollar we raise before the next deadline helps us reach more voters, run more ads, and make sure every county stays fully accessible to every Texan who wants to cast a ballot.
Sign now. Then chip in if you can. [https://act.vikkigoodwin.com/dont-mess-with-texas-voters/]
ADD YOUR NAME [https://act.vikkigoodwin.com/dont-mess-with-texas-voters/]
For Texas voters,
Rep. Vikki Goodwin
P.S. The Lieutenant Governor controls the Texas Senate calendar, which means Dan Patrick decides which bills get a vote and which ones die quietly. That includes every bill about election access, voter ID, and polling place availability. [https://act.vikkigoodwin.com/dont-mess-with-texas-voters/] Add your name to fight voter suppression, then help us elect the first woman as Lt Governor in Texas history. [https://act.vikkigoodwin.com/dont-mess-with-texas-voters/]

Raised in Dallas, she graduated from UT and the LBJ School of Public Affairs. She’s currently serving her fourth term in the Texas Legislature, representing parts of Austin and the Lake Travis area.
Throughout her life, Vikki Goodwin has strived to build a better Texas for her family and her constituents. Now, she’s running to unseat Trump’s right-hand man in Texas, Dan Patrick, and become the first woman Lt. Governor in our state’s history.
Rep. Goodwin is a passionate supporter of public schools and has passed laws that expand healthcare and protect children and survivors of domestic violence. As Lt. name: Zohran Mamdani
subject: Unsolicited advice
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Zohran for NYC 2029**
body:
The only expectation I seek to reset is that of small expectations.
#
A few months ago, as I was preparing to be sworn in as Mayor, I received some unsolicited advice about what I should say in my Inaugural Address.
I was told that this would be the occasion for me to reset expectations. That I should use the opportunity to encourage the people of New York to ask for little and expect even less.
But I did no such thing — because that’s not why I ran for Mayor. Today and every day, I want to reaffirm to you that _the only expectation I seek to reset is that of small expectations._
With you by my side, I will keep uplifting the needs, hopes, and dreams of everyday people. We may not always succeed. **But never will we be accused of lacking the courage to try.**
The powerful movement we’ve built together is about improving working people’s lives. It’s about organizing for progress today so that we can build a better, more affordable tomorrow. That is the work I am asking you to be a part of right now:
**[Will you sign up today to join this movement and help reset expectations for the better?](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22956?t=1&akid=1700%2E2118727%2EkLmisE)**
Thank you,
Zohran

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Today is a BIG day for our movement.

It’s primary election day in Michigan and Missouri, where we can unseat
two Do-Nothing Democratic incumbents and replace them with progressive
champions.

In MI-13, we recruited Donavan McKinney as our first new candidate of the
cycle to take on self-serving multimillionaire Rep. Shri Thanedar.

AIPAC’s network, the Crypto lobby, and corporate interests like utility
monopoly DTE are trying to save Shri’s seat, while Donavan is ready to
fight for Medicare for All, end U.S. complicity in the Gaza genocide, and
lower costs for Detroit families.

In MO-01, it’s the rematch we’ve been waiting two years for: former
congresswoman Cori Bush is challenging AIPAC shill, Rep. Wesley Bell.

The pro-Israel lobby group spent a historic $12 million to defeat Cori in
2024. This time, they dropped $3 million to defend Wesley, but with people
power, Cori can get back to fighting for the bold changes that Democratic
voters in St. Louis and beyond deserve.

If Donavan and Cori win these elections today, they’re all but certain to
go to Congress next year. Then, we have just one last primary fight left
on Thursday in Tennessee, where we’re working to elect Justin J. Pearson.
That’s why these primaries are so important right now.

Once this primary season ends, we need to rapidly shift our focus to get
at least two Justice Democrats over the finish line in the general
election.

It’s primary election day in Michigan and Missouri, where we can unseat two Do-Nothing Democratic incumbents and replace them with progressive champions. In MI-13, we recruited Donavan McKinney as our first new candidate of the cycle to take on self-serving multimillionaire Rep. Shri Thanedar. AIPAC’s network, the Crypto lobby, and corporate interests like utility monopoly DTE are trying to save Shri’s seat, while Donavan is ready to fight for Medicare for All, end U.S. complicity in the Gaza genocide, and lower costs for Detroit families. In MO-01, it’s the rematch we’ve been waiting two years for: former congresswoman Cori Bush is challenging AIPAC shill, Rep. Wesley Bell. The pro-Israel lobby group spent a historic $12 million to defeat Cori in 2024. This time, they dropped $3 million to defend Wesley, but with people power, Cori can get back to fighting for the bold changes that Democratic voters in St. Louis and beyond deserve. If Donavan and Cori win these elections today, they’re all but certain to go to Congress next year. People counted me out.
When I decided to take my experience and run for Congress, people didn't think I could win. But I knew what I was fighting for, and I knew I had a grassroots team that never stopped believing in me. Together, we made history. You helped elect me as one of the first Native American women elected to Congress and then the first Native American Cabinet Secretary in U.S. history.

MAGA donors have already poured hundreds of thousands of dollars into this race, and this poll will only encourage them to spend even more trying to buy New Mexico's future, flip it red, and bring Donald Trump's extreme agenda to our state. | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation to Deb Haaland and Battleground Wisconsin will process immediately: | | | | | | I've faced long odds before, Derek. I raised my child as a single mom, learning how to stretch every dollar, work multiple jobs, and keep going even when things felt impossible. People counted me out. When I decided to take my experience and run for Congress, people didn't think I could win. But I knew what I was fighting for, and I knew I had a grassroots team that never stopped believing in me. Together, we made history. You helped elect me as one of the first Native American women elected to Congress and then the first Native American Cabinet Secretary in U.S. history. And while this poll might make some people think they can count me out again, I know better. I know what this grassroots team is capable of. Because this fight has never been about a poll or a title. It’s about fighting for New Mexicans and delivering real results: lowering costs for working families, strengthening our schools, protecting our public lands, expanding access to healthcare, investing in mental health and addiction resources, and creating more opportunities in every corner of our state. And we kept it.

| | | | |
---
Peter,
When we launched this campaign last September, I never would have imagined the 5th Congressional District would become a 17-county district stretching from Middle Tennessee all the way to the Mississippi River.
[](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/ZqdxdgoKc76qtwMnzCTfcA~~/AAUS1hA~/MZsFj-U5ltmiow_YMgpsQUv3tjWtS1L_fUeVI8YmUL4ZaPTWAlVsOsvfBLSycqjbYDK5G-OZvfPEyju3FHMiZM0VTHSVy_LRuoEtJKcOuIC6PJ68RZLZsjJfFbSzCo1l5SVzL5avT9kWjV8pGxkGX6OXEQbLVH5UKnpfF_kkJzFcCZFdW6z40djH3etqc_awDJLg8VJmrCOg8vzTMc9WwdXF3exDCfoknMqrHSNCp9q7TE6jvTT629eSeCSe-jf-)
But here we are. And I am proud to tell you that we have now visited all 17 counties before August 6th. Our last stops were Benton, Stewart and Houston counties, and they were worth every mile.
I made a promise that no county in this district would be overlooked. Not the big ones, not the small ones, not the ones that were drawn in at the last minute by politicians trying to rig a map. Every single one of them deserves a congressman who shows up and makes them proud.
We have done the work. Now we need your help to finish it.

I made a promise that no county in this district would be overlooked. Not the big ones, not the small ones, not the ones that were drawn in at the last minute by politicians trying to rig a map. Every single one of them deserves a congressman who shows up and makes them proud. We have done the work. Now we need your help to finish it. body:
I want you to hear me on this

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136614884/638021072/1992965070?refcode=email_080426_hearme&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NDI3Yjk4MC0yMzkwLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=x8b0dieDga8N96StDQks4uTuQhMTwXq8ErTqbuIhM2A=) Derek, some politicians love to talk a big game about freedom. They say the word over and over again, and claim that their idea of freedom should rule above all else. But hear me on this:
* It’s not freedom when the far-right tells us what books our children can and cannot read.
* It’s not freedom when politicians tell women what they can and cannot do with their bodies.
* It’s not freedom when Donald Trump’s reckless tariffs drive up costs, and Pennsylvanians are forced to pay the price.
* And it sure as hell isn’t freedom when folks like my opponent put Trump’s agenda ahead of Pennsylvania — from backing cuts to healthcare to rubber-stamping the far-right’s attacks on our rights.

That’s not freedom. That’s _control._ Here in Pennsylvania, we believe in real freedom: The freedom to get ahead, the freedom to choose, the freedom to feel safe and be safe, the freedom to provide for your family, and the freedom to build a future without politicians standing in your way. That’s what this campaign is all about. The FTC calls it "surveillance pricing" when it hits you as a customer. They call it "algorithmic wage discrimination" when it hits you as a worker. But it's the same weapon pointed in two directions. It watches what you click, what you refuse, what you accept, your zip code, your medical bills, your credit card debt -- and then it calculates not what something is worth, but what it thinks you can be made to tolerate.
Airlines are predicting what you can be squeezed for on a ticket. Grocery chains are swapping paper price tags for digital ones that shift the instant it's profitable. Some stores are installing cameras to estimate your age and gender in the aisle. The FTC found pricing firms working with more than 250 mega retailers to build personalized profiles -- individual by individual -- to find the highest price any one person would actually pay.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1d0e9d3c-4687-4950-ade0-500168bc582e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And it's not just customers. The same technology decides how little to pay workers.
I know what this feels like from the inside. I drove for DoorDash as a broke college student raising a child alone. I worked UPS. I worked the Postal Service -- where at least the system was legible. You knew your rate. You knew your route. Nobody was quietly A/B testing your paycheck.
Uber used to connect what a rider paid to what a driver earned. Now those are two separate algorithms with no relationship. Uber's cut rose from roughly one-third to nearly half of every dollar -- sometimes two-thirds. And the biggest pay cuts fell on the drivers who almost never turned down a ride. The system learned who could least afford to say no. The more desperate you were, the less it paid you.
Now that model has moved into healthcare. Gig nursing apps are buying data on nurses' financial distress and using it to low-ball the ones who look most unable to refuse. Same license. Same shift. Same patient. Lower pay -- because the algorithm read your credit report.
Uber's CEO has personally admitted to this. DoorDash's billionaire co-founder is a personal investor in one of these nursing apps. These aren't faceless algorithms. These are specific human beings, with names, choosing to build systems that extract wealth from you at your most vulnerable.
This is not some unstoppable consequence of technology. This is a policy choice Congress is making right now by refusing to act. The FTC investigation was shut down when Trump took office. A bill to ban AI price gouging and wage fixing is rotting in committee. Maryland and Connecticut have already acted. But for crying out loud, this should be a national standard. Americans shouldn't be protected or exposed based on their zip code.
Here's what Congress must do: ban the use of financial distress data to set wages or prices. Require companies to disclose when an algorithm is setting your pay or your price and what data it used. Empower the FTC to finish the work political appointees tried to bury. And make single price, single wage enforceable in law -- not just an assumption we all thought was the floor, until it turned out to be quicksand.
I've driven those routes. I've felt the app making decisions about me I was never allowed to see. I'm running for Congress because your need should never be turned into a weapon against you. Fair businesses strengthen countries. Predatory ones destroy the nation that enables them.
We need a fair price, a fair wage, and a government strong enough to defend both.
Care. Courage. The Constitution.

| | | Peter, My name is Justin J. Pearson. I’m a public servant, community organizer, and proud fighter running to represent Tennessee’s 9th Congressional District in the August 6 primary election. For far too long, the hardworking people of District 9 have been neglected by our government. As an xAI data center tries to use our drinking water to cool the same computers that are trying to take our jobs, our families are also confronting some of the highest levels of poverty in the nation and an epidemic of gun violence that has become the leading cause of death for children in my district. In District 9 and across the country, we _need_ and _deserve_ representatives who understand the struggles being faced by our communities, and who are ready to fight to make things right. **That’s why I’m running for Congress: to be a relentless champion for the people of my district, and to help build a government that works for working people everywhere.** **[But I need your support to get there. Can I count on you to split a contribution between my campaign and the Working Families Party, so we can grow our movement and get out the vote in the final days of this campaign?](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9C7Pgef-t6X3_fRWEoOXwGy9CCh-C-aC212QfLnZB8kk603yeYUNUEKHIbdyodBI4MaNaik721mKlIxOSCsdkFDQzNPf1mYtULknzYDFCURNpbWUfY_kBDTb1TDNhytY2xxFfekyVNlXt_gBvDDcbQte1wYlQx0XPyCag5Q_-6dX5oV2ItpFPgmhvx_TANemLb_0Zry4ghT9777NHXdS7NYVZakdVhvM3lXTdqyFMsOQVe8sc8KDza9iqLtgHBuF_P1-UqjCXDvbkQW25EbblA1lZDchozi_BzzbXjoVKiFYrWpdNN-NK14-YXJQQUIjdaqOBFphdh1C9q-S0OeSoJw/4sw/BSMVunISRay9u9fHXzyRxA/h0/h001.reret6TVaRqNqR-O32oAUcVGcce_iBUpGM1ihp5XVl8)** **[Donate $10 »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9C7Pgef-t6X3_fRWEoOXwGy9CCh-C-aC212QfLnZB8kkslSz0bRC2BLZ2Pu0hT6JZsw_1VJYtWnbeQTF5q0awkg6DHCkafW_rz2QR5lJR2CHUD22sAnC-PIPqS-_cbft0yMwpqacAeg_T-X4nRnZpLPv5zXdSiueR3-KmcNdPboxd8OeFwkHhxRi8W97lnk-cmMttqzpS9RrCNYyi2WUwvjalSK48w3gUVmtmUrTR26LCS2hmRar5oelltiA0uIKklL544m_JD_rNqa1UlyORvMsFrICAvuuhGGPcrF1pMQZbGd_cK7S_AcnwytFNlS_6BsXLO8M1-PxQUSaaaQPkJw/4sw/BSMVunISRay9u9fHXzyRxA/h1/h001._qg0_U20xa6ZLqgSz8Bw59-hfKHUnm35taUEetHBwKk)** **Since I joined the State Assembly in 2023, the far-right has done everything in their power to silence me as I work to protect our rights and support our communities.** When three 9-year-olds and three staff members were shot and killed at the Covenant School in Nashville, I protested at the state capitol to stop the gun violence epidemic. Instead of taking action to pass gun control and prevent more tragedies, my Republican colleagues voted to expel me from the state legislature. **_But I kept fighting._** And a week later, I was reinstated to my seat to continue the work. When the Supreme Court released its disgraceful, anti-democracy decision in _Louisiana v. Callais,_ Tennessee Republicans enacted a new, racist congressional map that eliminated TN-09 — the only majority-Black district in the state, and the district I call home — and stripped me of my committee assignments for protesting it. **_But I kept fighting._** And on the campaign trail in my remade district, we’re seeing a power and a thirst for justice in our community that we haven’t seen, felt, or experienced in a long time. **And when I get to Congress, no matter what Trump and his extremist friends try to pull,_I will keep fighting._** The only way we lose this country, this democracy, is by quitting. clean_body: | | | Peter, My name is Justin J. Pearson. I’m a public servant, community organizer, and proud fighter running to represent Tennessee’s 9th Congressional District in the August 6 primary election. For far too long, the hardworking people of District 9 have been neglected by our government. As an xAI data center tries to use our drinking water to cool the same computers that are trying to take our jobs, our families are also confronting some of the highest levels of poverty in the nation and an epidemic of gun violence that has become the leading cause of death for children in my district. In District 9 and across the country, we need and deserve representatives who understand the struggles being faced by our communities, and who are ready to fight to make things right. That’s why I’m running for Congress: to be a relentless champion for the people of my district, and to help build a government that works for working people everywhere. Since I joined the State Assembly in 2023, the far-right has done everything in their power to silence me as I work to protect our rights and support our communities. When three 9-year-olds and three staff members were shot and killed at the Covenant School in Nashville, I protested at the state capitol to stop the gun violence epidemic. Instead of taking action to pass gun control and prevent more tragedies, my Republican colleagues voted to expel me from the state legislature. But I kept fighting. And a week later, I was reinstated to my seat to continue the work. When the Supreme Court released its disgraceful, anti-democracy decision in Louisiana v. Callais, Tennessee Republicans enacted a new, racist congressional map that eliminated TN-09 — the only majority-Black district in the state, and the district I call home — and stripped me of my committee assignments for protesting it. But I kept fighting. And on the campaign trail in my remade district, we’re seeing a power and a thirst for justice in our community that we haven’t seen, felt, or experienced in a long time. And when I get to Congress, no matter what Trump and his extremist friends try to pull,I will keep fighting. The only way we lose this country, this democracy, is by quitting. But if we never quit, we can never lose. In love and service, Rep. Justin J. Pearson Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. # [From The DAV National Conference: The Warning Signs Before a Veteran Crisis](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=4399133&post_id=209811887&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjA5ODExODg3LCJpYXQiOjE3ODU4NjM0NzgsImV4cCI6MTc4ODQ1NTQ3OCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTQzOTkxMzMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.nfLfZsqEy6ix7Ngq2n53pmYRnjdS1yq_uAeQuvdQY4Q)
### Distress, bad actors, caregiver strain and mental health are often treated as separate problems. A growing coalition is beginning to connect them before it is too late

_[The Washington Post](https://substack.com/redirect/e517ec11-15f0-4416-8705-1d3ded961d4f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ reported today that trade schools defrauded the GI Bill of $300 million while leaving thousands of veterans with worthless credentials and broken promises. But fraud isn't the only way veterans get trapped, though. Structural fragmentation does the same damage.
Every year, roughly [6,400 veterans die by suicide](https://substack.com/redirect/eeb8c139-b1db-48a7-bdef-640ace3eefe8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) - more than 17 a day - most within 12 months of their transition out of service. Although veterans compose only 7.6% of the US population, [nearly 14% of American adult suicides are among veterans. ](https://substack.com/redirect/a0007772-a727-47da-81a7-aa82382949d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) tracks the risk factors with precision.
**Financial Risk is a Proven Risk Factor**
The VA knows that financial distress can push a veteran toward crisis in its own right. Falling behind on a mortgage, accumulating high-interest debt, or losing a job or the income of a spouse who has become a full-time caregiver can create a constant pressure that reaches into every part of daily life. Shame makes it harder to talk about. A veteran may begin withdrawing long before anyone records a change in mood or a suicidal thought in a medical chart. By the time the crisis becomes visible to the healthcare system, its earliest warning signs may already have been sitting for months in missed payments, overdraft notices, and unopened envelopes.
The difficulty begins when that veteran asks for help. A mental health professional may recognize the danger without having any way to stop a foreclosure. A financial counselor may help restructure the debt without knowing that the client has begun thinking about suicide. A caregiver organization may see that a spouse has left work to care for an injured veteran without seeing how quickly the lost income is destabilizing the household. The veteran is then sent from one part of the system to another: another phone number, another intake form, another organization with different eligibility rules. Each referral may be reasonable on its own. Together, they place the burden of coordinating the response on the person least equipped to carry it.
This gap doesn't show up in agency budgets or congressional testimony. It's not a policy failure you can vote on. It's the space between knowing what kills veterans and having an actual system to stop it. And it's where most of the preventable deaths happen.
Last month, two great organizations began bringing those services closer together.
Veteran Debt Assistance (VDA) donated [$100,000](https://substack.com/redirect/37351cb6-b8a0-40d3-be47-d2dcaa034cc5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to Disabled American Veterans (DAV) to expand their Caregivers Support program. The amount is modest beside federal spending on veterans' healthcare. What matters is the premise behind it: financial strain, caregiving demands and mental health often deteriorate together. This partnership treats them as parts of the same crisis rather than problems to be routed through separate systems. Stabilizing the veteran may require stabilizing the household around them.

**Patients Over Paperwork**
For decades, veterans have moved from one system to another for medical care, benefits and support at home. Each office may handle its own piece competently, but veterans are still left carrying the full burden between them.
I remember what that fragmentation looked like when I returned from Iraq in 2004. I carried my medical records in a folder. When I moved, changed providers or needed care somewhere else, I often had to explain my medical history from scratch. Doctors in Philadelphia or Bucks County couldn't see what doctors in Baghdad or Fort Bragg had already treated. A medication change made in one system might not appear in another. The burden of maintaining continuity fell on the patient, including patients suffering from brain injuries, chronic pain, post-traumatic stress or severe depression.
I coauthored legislation while in Congress back in 2008 to mandate the DOD/VA to have an integrated Electronic Health Record (EHR) While the DOD implemented on-time and on-budget with 100% implementation, the Veterans Health Administration is finally progressing swiftly with Oracle in a public-private partnership to replace their EHR with the same unified, joint electronic health record system DOD uses - the largest digital transformation in VA's history. Whether someone receives care through the Department of Defense or the VA, clinicians should be able to see the same essential information. A prescription filled in Michigan is visible to a doctor in Florida. A mental health note written in Ohio follows the veteran to Alaska. It's what should have existed twenty years ago.
Better information, however, does not automatically produce timely care. A medical record can show exactly what a veteran needs and still leave that veteran waiting. The real test is whether the information leads to action and whether the organizations involved can see the same crisis in full.
Former Navy Chief Medical Informatics Officer, Dr. James Ellzy, now Oracle VP, and I had the honor of holding a fireside chat at the DAV Conference yesterday, listening to any concerns our fellow veterans might be feeling (disclosure: I'm the Chairman of the Oracle Health board).
The VA's unified electronic health record is beginning to reveal where veterans still encounter unnecessary delays. At our fireside chat yesterday, a Navy veteran raised one example: veterans in crisis who call for emergency refills of psychiatric medication may still be told they must first see their doctor.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fd7536b2-eec8-4a24-8332-4cff17385128?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Here with Navy Veteran Dr. James Ellzy
That requirement was easier to defend when pharmacists and physicians could not reliably see the same information. A shared record changes the calculation. Providers can review a veteran's prescriptions, treatment history and recent care across the network. Rules built for a fragmented system can now be reconsidered in light of information that is already available.
The pharmacy side shows how this works. The VA runs the largest pharmacy network in the world. Early versions of the new system struggled with prescription processing--a veteran waiting for a mail-order refill wouldn't get bridging medication fast enough. Rather than accept that friction, the system was redesigned. Now pharmacists can issue short-term medications while the veteran waits, reducing the gap between crisis and care.
The system remains imperfect. But the principle is becoming clearer: patients should not be placed at risk simply because information, authority and responsibility sit in different parts of the bureaucracy.
This is where the actual evidence base matters.
**Building a National Coalition with Face the Fight**
Since [Face the Fight](https://substack.com/redirect/2a593fba-9217-4a46-865c-dba50659f14a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) launched in June 2023, its coalition of more than 300 organizations has distributed over $41 million across 83 projects. It's been an honor to serve as their Honorary Co-Chair with JoAnn Bass, former Air Force Master Chief, their highest-ranking enlisted airman. These initiatives have conducted more than one million suicide-risk screenings, initiated over 250,000 conversations about safely storing firearms and other lethal means, and provided suicide-specific care to more than 110,000 veterans. Altogether, the coalition has reached [1.4 million veterans](https://substack.com/redirect/e21d54e2-beb5-4258-9530-b26a4528092d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), service members, family members, caregivers and survivors.
That emphasis on lethal means is especially important. Firearms were involved in 73.3 percent of veteran suicide deaths in 2023. A conversation about changing the code on a gun safe, temporarily giving a family member the key, or otherwise creating distance from a weapon can interrupt a crisis before it becomes irreversible.
Most veterans (53%) are not even enrolled in the VA - and even among those who are, reaching out means confronting pride, stigma, the belief that you're supposed to handle this yourself. All of it adds up to silence. When a veteran finally does break through that barrier, they face a second problem: access to treatment that actually works.
Take, for example, [Prism](https://substack.com/redirect/eb88b28e-29c5-4bca-829f-475f00de13d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a prescription self-modulation treatment developed by GrayMatters Health for PTSD that's FDA-cleared and effective. It works by retraining the brain's response to threat through controlled sensory feedback. For some veterans, it's the intervention that finally pulls them out of the cycle when medication and talk therapy haven't. Not enough providers know about it, and insurance coverage is fragmented. Access depends on where you live, what you're insured through, and whether your VA medical center has decided to offer it.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0445df5c-8a67-4616-94ac-2440ab4429cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
With [Kirk Thelander](https://substack.com/redirect/ef0e8ffe-c526-4a76-9996-a6473c20c1d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Chief Commercial Officer of GrayMatters Health.
The Face the Fight model works because it connects three functions: prevention, connection, and access to evidence-based care. Treatment options like Prism exist for the clinical piece. Peer networks provide the ongoing connection. It's still fragmented. But it's less fragmented than it was.
**Call to Action**
While only 7.6% of Americans are veterans, it takes all of us to be part of the solution - and not just a 'whole of government' approach but a 'whole of nation' one. If you know a veteran who's falling behind financially, tell them about VDA. It's free, and they understand that money and mental health are connected. If you know someone caring for a veteran, tell them about DAV's caregiver program and the Face the Fight initiative led by the Elizabeth Dole Foundation. If PTSD is the problem, tell them how Prism is an option and mental health providers are a phone call or text away.
The organizations are there with interventions that work. Luckily, most are good actors.
It's time we face the Fight. Together.

Donald Trump is so intent on making life more expensive for the American people that he just can’t seem to stop breaking laws in order to do it.
For more than a year, he’s been throwing our economy into chaos by imposing illegal tariffs — and we’re all paying the price. In 2025, American consumers and businesses paid nearly 90% of the costs of tariffs.
Now, Trump is not just doubling but tripling down on his failed economic policies — and as usual, doing it unlawfully.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. # [Trump turns on Big Oil over "too much" profits](https://substack.com/redirect/ce8615ff-a1a6-4bc1-870b-99785ec6fd55?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
President Donald Trump on Monday **[criticized ExxonMobil and Chevron for sharply higher profits during the Iran war,](https://substack.com/redirect/d9e48c4b-6302-467d-8ea5-750fd91fcd3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** saying they are making too much money based on a shortage and should cut consumer prices.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ce8615ff-a1a6-4bc1-870b-99785ec6fd55?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Exxon doubles quarterly earnings:** ExxonMobil reported $14.5 billion in second-quarter 2026 earnings, double the amount from the same period last year while oil prices rose above $100 a barrel at times.
* **Chevron posts highest earnings:** Chevron pulled in $12 billion, posting its highest quarterly earnings in at least six years according to reports on the companies' results last week.
* **Demands giveback and cuts:** Trump said the companies ought to give some of that back to the public and better cut the retail price, the consumer price, stating he is not happy about it.
* **Prices fall as tensions ease:** Oil prices fell again Monday as signs emerged that U.S.-Iran tensions were easing, with Trump predicting gasoline prices would drop through the floor when the war ends.

# [How Mamdani's tax mistake could empty New York buildings](https://substack.com/redirect/ce8615ff-a1a6-4bc1-870b-99785ec6fd55?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
New York City homeowners received an extra month to prove primary residency after **[Mayor Zohran Mamdani's pied-a-terre tax public roll](https://substack.com/redirect/4cc1e3d0-75b7-477f-9553-65a363ad0c1f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** of more than 960,000 properties caused confusion, as a developer warns of backfire on everyday residents.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ce8615ff-a1a6-4bc1-870b-99785ec6fd55?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **List exceeds estimates thirtyfold:** The Department of Finance published full names and addresses for more than 960,000 properties, about 30 times larger than the original estimate of 13,000 to 31,000 affected by the tax.
* **Targets non-primary residences:** The tax approved by state lawmakers in May under Gov. Kathy Hochul applies to non-primary residences valued above $5 million and condos or co-ops valued at $1 million or more.
* **Developer warns of backfire:** Aria Development Group founding partner David Arditi said if high-earning taxpayers leave, the impact shows up much more prominently in the budget of those who will stay behind.
* **Miami outsells New York luxury:** Miami has already outsold New York in ultra-luxury deals this year as sales teams field more calls from motivated New York buyers and the Florida exodus gains traction.

# [Palantir CEO warns AI companies want to addict you like drugs](https://substack.com/redirect/ce8615ff-a1a6-4bc1-870b-99785ec6fd55?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Palantir CEO Alex Karp on Monday renewed attacks on frontier AI labs including OpenAI and Anthropic[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/8d96a58f-319d-4865-aa14-1a35cf6f5da5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[for trying to drug addict enterprises to a future they control,](https://substack.com/redirect/8d96a58f-319d-4865-aa14-1a35cf6f5da5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/8d96a58f-319d-4865-aa14-1a35cf6f5da5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)urging companies to keep data and IP in-house.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ce8615ff-a1a6-4bc1-870b-99785ec6fd55?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Enterprises should own models:** Karp said enterprises should control their own models and work with companies like Palantir that offer an application layer allowing the business to keep the data in-house.
* **Skeptical of security claims:** Although OpenAI and Anthropic said customer data is secure and is not used to train their models unless users opt in, Karp said he is not buying it.
* **Defends open-weight approach:** Karp argued Chinese models cannot be blamed for distilling U.S. models when the frontier labs distilled all the value of intellectual property everywhere.
* **Palantir reports strong growth:** Overall revenue grew 93% over last year and the AI software company's U.S. commercial business jumped nearly 150% in the second quarter.

# [Commercial boom sends Palantir shares soaring 16%](https://substack.com/redirect/ce8615ff-a1a6-4bc1-870b-99785ec6fd55?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Palantir shares **[surged nearly 16% in premarket trading](https://substack.com/redirect/9b967977-bf59-4b6c-a476-94255640e3a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Tuesday after reporting second-quarter revenue of $1.94 billion that rose 93% year-over-year and beat estimates of $1.8 billion, powered by 149% U.S. commercial growth.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ce8615ff-a1a6-4bc1-870b-99785ec6fd55?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **U.S. commercial sales climb:** Commercial revenue climbed 149% year-over-year to $764 million while government revenue advanced 90% to $809 million, driving overall results well above the $1.8 billion consensus.
* **Full-year revenue guidance raised:** The company lifted its 2026 revenue outlook to the $8.15 billion to $8.16 billion range from prior estimates near $7.65 billion, with commercial revenue guided above $3.424 billion.
* **Record deal activity reported:** Palantir closed 220 deals of $1 million or more including 73 exceeding $10 million, while adjusted free cash flow reached $1.22 billion versus expectations of $1 billion.
* **Sovereign AI demand drives:** CEO Alex Karp called the quarter otherworldly and **[credited the sovereign AI revolutio](https://substack.com/redirect/13f8b4aa-d0ba-4929-963e-c1e594bb47c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** n as customers seek independence to keep data private from frontier labs like OpenAI and Google.

# [Caterpillar stock explodes after $20.5B record revenue](https://substack.com/redirect/ce8615ff-a1a6-4bc1-870b-99785ec6fd55?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Caterpillar stock **[jumped 10% in premarket trading Tuesday](https://substack.com/redirect/2665f564-1252-4a34-98aa-5aaa0bf76266?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after the heavy equipment maker reported second-quarter sales and revenues increased 24% to a record $20.5 billion.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ce8615ff-a1a6-4bc1-870b-99785ec6fd55?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Record sales milestone hit** : CEO Joe Creed said this is the first time in company history that Caterpillar generated over $20 billion in sales and revenues in a single quarter.
* **Backlog climbs to record** : The company's backlog rose to $72.1 billion, up 92% from the same time last year, powered by strong order rates across all three primary segments.
* **AI infrastructure demand wins** : Caterpillar has become a winner of the AI trade by providing the massive power infrastructure required to keep data centers running.
* **Margins and yearly gains** : Operating profit margin was 20.9% for the second quarter of 2026 compared with 17.3% for the second quarter of 2025, with the stock up 38% year to date.

# [Your boss can now track every Kalshi prediction bet you make](https://substack.com/redirect/ce8615ff-a1a6-4bc1-870b-99785ec6fd55?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Kalshi is announcing a Tuesday partnership with compliance technology company Comply, whose software for more than 5,000 firms **[will monitor employee trades on event contracts and perpetual futures.](https://substack.com/redirect/589cdbad-9dab-4c9c-a92c-4c4350a4312f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ce8615ff-a1a6-4bc1-870b-99785ec6fd55?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Compliance data integration** : Comply is adding Kalshi's prediction markets trade data to its regulatory software so employers can see employees' event contract trades and enforce policies.
* **Institutional visibility demand** : Kalshi vice president Max Crowley said firms seeking institutional trading expect the same compliance visibility they have for traditional securities and digital assets.
* **Monitoring avoids bans** : Kalshi chief compliance officer Sudhir Jain said without data companies may ban all event contract trading, but technology now allows monitoring instead.
* **Prior partnership expansion** : The deal follows Kalshi's June partnership with StarCompliance and Comply's existing Polymarket coverage through ZenLedger for prediction market trades.

**Below is an excerpt from**** _The Atlantic:_**
_There are a few ways to think about Iowa. You might imagine America’s 29th state as the land of corn and pigs (20 million hogs can’t be wrong, reads my favorite T-shirt for sale at the Eastern Iowa Airport). Maybe you associate it with Field of Dreams, Caitlin Clark, or the future birthplace of Captain James T. Kirk._
_You might also picture Iowa as flat, like a pancake. But you would be wrong. Iowa is not even in the top five flattest U.S. states, which is a fact I was considering last month as I watched Josh Turek size up a daunting set of stairs in a hilly Cedar Rapids neighborhood. After a moment’s consideration, the 47-year-old Democrat, who uses a wheelchair, shook his head, deciding against it. It would be the only house that Turek would skip that afternoon as he knocked on doors in the warm spring sunlight. At all the other homes, he followed the same elaborate routine without appearing to break a sweat: lowering his body out of his chair and onto the ground; hoisting himself backwards up a step using just his arms; yanking the wheelchair up after him; and repeating that until he reached the doorbell, which is when he would announce, “Hi! I’m Josh Turek, and I’m running for the U.S. Senate!”_
_In his bid to replace Republican Senator Joni Ernst, Turek is hoping to correct what he believes is another popular misconception about Iowa: that it is a red state._
All across Iowa’s 99 counties, people keep telling me that they feel more hopeful than they have in a decade or more.
_I feel the same way._
And it isn’t just happening in Iowa. This sentiment is shared by millions of working people all across this country.
This is a once-in-a-generation opportunity. The stars are aligning in our favor. Trump won Iowa by 11 points in 2024, now it’s TIED in multiple polls.
Experts, pundits, and even our opponents know this is unlike any election in recent history.
My Trump-endorsed opponent is backed up by $50 million in dark money. Able Dems and I need your urgent support to keep our TV ads, digital ads, get-out-the-vote tour, door-knocking, phone banking, voter registration, and _so much more,_ going through the fall _._

A federal judge refused to block Donald Trump’s executive order to create a federal voter list and limit mail voting.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]
FIGHT BACK [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]
That means the fight to protect free, fair, and accessible elections just suffered a blow — and the stakes could not be higher.
Trump and his allies are still trying to sow distrust in our elections, restrict access to the ballot box, and give the federal government unprecedented control over how Americans vote. They’re targeting vote-by-mail even after repeated audits and investigations confirmed there was no widespread fraud in the 2020 election.
And make no mistake: this is exactly why we need everyone on board, fighting back harder than ever to save our democracy and the rule of law.
In Oregon, we know vote-by-mail works. We’ve spent decades building a system that is secure, accessible, and trusted by voters across the political spectrum. But national attacks on voting rights don’t stop at state borders.
As Secretary of State, I’ll do everything in my power to protect Oregon voters, defend election workers from political intimidation, and ensure our elections remain free from partisan interference.
But I can’t do this alone. We to prove that Oregonians are ready to stand together against these attacks on democracy. Will you chip in before midnight to help me continue this fight? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]
The courts may not have stopped this latest attack yet — but voting rights advocates are continuing the legal battle, and we must continue organizing, mobilizing, and preparing for what comes next.
This campaign is about protecting democracy itself. And it will take all of us working together to win.
Thank you,
Tobias Read

name: Autism Health
subject: Cocktails for a Cause Fundraiser is Tomorrow!
body:
|
---
| |
---
| |
# Join Our Cocktails for A Cause Fundraiser
---
|
---
| We are excited to invite you to our upcoming **Cocktails for A Cause** fundraiser — tomorrow — benefiting **Autism Health** this **Wednesday, August 5, 2026** , at **6:00 PM **at **The Park Club in Costa Mesa, CA. **Registration starts at 5:30 PM. This special evening will bring together supporters, families, professionals, and community leaders for a night of connection, purpose, and giving back. Guests will enjoy cocktails, networking, an inspiring **presentation from Dr. Dayan Goodenowe** , and both a **live auction** and **silent auction **filled with exciting items and experiences. Will will also have live entertainment for you to enjoy. Tickets are **$85 per person** and proceeds from the evening will help support Autism Health’s ongoing mission to provide education, resources, support programs, and outreach for families impacted by autism and neurological conditions. We hope you will join us for this meaningful evening as we come together to make a difference in the lives of so many families.
---
| [BUY TICKETS HERE](https://autismhealth.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7c0b21e245e40197b3670bea2&id=6c515ea7f2&e=3a42edfdc4 "BUY TICKETS HERE")
---
|
---
|
# Join Our August Support Group
---
|
---
| This August, we are taking a break from our Monthly Educational Webinar and focusing on something equally important: **supporting and connecting our parents.** Please join us for our **Parent Support Group on Wednesday, August 26th at 5:00 PM PST / 8:00 PM EST via Zoom**. This gathering is an opportunity for parents and caregivers impacted by autism to come together in a welcoming and supportive environment where you can share experiences, ask questions, exchange resources, and connect with others who truly understand the journey. We know that caring for a child or loved one with autism can bring both incredible joys and significant challenges. Sometimes one of the most valuable resources is simply having a community of people who understand. Our Parent Support Group provides a space to learn from one another, discuss what is working for your family, hear the experiences of other parents, and build meaningful connections. **There will be no Monthly Webinar during August.** Our educational webinar series will resume following our summer break. **Advance registration is required to attend the Parent Support Group.** Please register using the Zoom link below to reserve your spot and receive the meeting information. We look forward to spending this time together and continuing to build a strong, informed, and supportive Autism Health community.
---
| [REGISTER HERE](https://autismhealth.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7c0b21e245e40197b3670bea2&id=64068767de&e=3a42edfdc4 "REGISTER HERE")
---
|
---
|
# July Discount Extended to August 7th!
---
|
---
| **Don't miss out! This is your last chance to receive 50% off your AHS ticket!** There has never been a better time to reserve your seat for the **2027 Autism Health Summit**! We have extended the discount to receive **50% OFF** your in person admission with promo code **AHS50**. Join us **April 29 - May 1, 2027** at the beautiful **Legacy Center Resort & Spa** in San Diego, California, for three inspiring days of education, collaboration, and community. The Autism Health Summit brings together leading physicians, researchers, practitioners, advocates, and families from around the world to explore the latest advances in autism research, integrative medicine, and whole person health. This exclusive offer **ends August 7th** and will not be available again, so reserve your seat today. As part of our mission to make education accessible to everyone, **Autism Health** proudly offers **scholarships for low income families** who may not otherwise be able to attend. We believe every family deserves access to trusted education, resources, and a supportive community, regardless of financial circumstances. You can access the application on our website under Our Services and click on Scholarships. **Register today and learn more using the links below.**
---
| [REGISTER HERE](https://autismhealth.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7c0b21e245e40197b3670bea2&id=8f53a04ae7&e=3a42edfdc4 "REGISTER HERE")
---
| Are you interested in partnering with Autism Health? During the month of **July** , organizations can receive **10% OFF all 2027 sponsorship packages** by using promo code **Sponsor10**. This is the perfect opportunity to showcase your organization while supporting one of the nation's premier autism education conferences.
---
| [REGISTER HERE](https://autismhealth.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7c0b21e245e40197b3670bea2&id=87327a46de&e=3a42edfdc4 "REGISTER HERE")
---
|
---
|
# Summer Movie Fundraiser Almost Over!
---
|
---
| Looking for a fun way to support Autism Health this summer? We are excited to partner with GroupRaise and Regal Cinemas for a special fundraising campaign that allows you to enjoy a night at the movies while supporting a great cause. For just **$30 per order** , you'll receive a Regal Movie Ticket Bundle that includes **two Standard 2D Movie Tickets** , redeemable at any Regal theater location nationwide. Best of all, **20% of every purchase** will be donated to Autism Health Inc. to help support our educational programs, support groups, webinars, scholarships, and research initiatives. Did you know that many Regal Cinemas locations also offer **Sensory Friendly Screenings**? These special screenings are designed to create a more comfortable movie-going experience for individuals with autism and sensory sensitivities, making this fundraiser even more meaningful for our community. Whether you're planning a family outing, date night, or looking for a unique gift, your purchase helps advance our mission of serving individuals and families impacted by autism and related neurological conditions. **Campaign Ends:** Monday, August 17, 2026 Thank you for supporting Autism Health Inc. Every ticket bundle purchased helps us continue making a difference in the lives of families around the world.
---
| [BUY TICKETS HERE](https://autismhealth.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7c0b21e245e40197b3670bea2&id=bb317a1ed4&e=3a42edfdc4 "BUY TICKETS HERE")
---
|

| **About Autism Health Inc.**
---
| Autism Health is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to educating individuals, families, and communities about autism spectrum disorder (ASD). Autism Health provides educational programs, workshops, events, research, and resources tailored to meet the diverse needs of those impacted by autism and other neurological disorders.

body:

Power, Prosperity, Peace
| Dear Friends, Here in New England, we were being drenched by downpours yesterday. Meanwhile, the West Coast is experiencing massive wildfires, notably in Washington. Canada is still battling blazes and parts of Europe are undergoing mega-fires. Many of us have experienced firsthand the far-reaching-effects of wildfire smoke; New England had poor air quality for a long stretch of July and parts of the Midwest experienced air quality so poor that it was "[off the charts](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/pDQqDTBYsqDALzvAONm6p7TUcJN1m0zS/click?signature=f5d2c3904fa0cb6f367d1ac2575130123b1ff9e9&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevanstonroundtable.com%2Fnewsletter-archive%2Fevanston-air-quality-so-bad-its-off-the-charts%2F)."
* * *
**Climate justice and action is needed now!**
* * *
Paige has signed the[ Green New Deal Pledge](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/pDQqDTBYsqDALzvAONm6p7TUcJN1m0zS/click?signature=51f5e4b68e532da78175b1d476b1262abb199a6a&url=https%3A%2F%2Fgndchampions.com%2Fcandidate-pledge%2F), committing to use her capacity as an elected official to swiftly advance the most progressive climate policy within the U.S. Congress. These policies include the[ Green New Deal Resolution](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/pDQqDTBYsqDALzvAONm6p7TUcJN1m0zS/click?signature=dd1ae23519dee5e0a220548abcf085a9a0d2b568&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.congress.gov%2Fbill%2F118th-congress%2Fhouse-resolution%2F319),[ the Green New Deal for Public Housing](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/pDQqDTBYsqDALzvAONm6p7TUcJN1m0zS/click?signature=868a4f963175869efa20dd45a606a82baf293514&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.congress.gov%2Fbill%2F118th-congress%2Fhouse-bill%2F7782%2Ftext), and the[ Environmental Justice for All Act](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/pDQqDTBYsqDALzvAONm6p7TUcJN1m0zS/click?signature=574886957197ee34b16597e4431bd06d2c7fc323&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.congress.gov%2Fbill%2F118th-congress%2Fsenate-bill%2F919).
* * *
**Why the Green New Deal?**
* * *
The[ Green New Deal Resolution](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/pDQqDTBYsqDALzvAONm6p7TUcJN1m0zS/click?signature=4a4b468d915ab4805aac512640b11077f632246a&url=https%3A%2F%2Fthesolutionsproject.org%2Finfo%2Fwhat-is-the-green-new-deal-proposal-summary-guide%2F) is a comprehensive approach to tackling climate change. Its key components include the reduction of greenhouse gas emissions to net zero and the transition to 100% renewable energy. It calls for the creation of millions of jobs and housing for all. The Green New Deal aims to[ structurally transform our country](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/pDQqDTBYsqDALzvAONm6p7TUcJN1m0zS/click?signature=5190f8d8f1f36b660f075ca1eac67dec2f2b98f3&url=https%3A%2F%2Fblumcenter.ucsb.edu%2Fsites%2Fdefault%2Ffiles%2Fsitefiles%2Fabout%2FThe%2520People%2527s%2520Guide%2520to%2520the%2520Green%2520New%2520Deal_0.pdf) to achieve environmental and economic justice. It calls for the promotion of justice and equity by stopping current, preventing future, and repairing historic oppression of marginalized groups. While the Green New Deal has not yet passed, its impact is undeniable. The Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act and the Inflation Reduction Act both incorporated major aspects of the Green New Deal. On a[ local level, cities](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/pDQqDTBYsqDALzvAONm6p7TUcJN1m0zS/click?signature=7b580ef7ad613e9563e2395f64d43ff0f5e2cbe4&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sierraclub.org%2Ftrade%2Fgreen-new-deal-already-underway-states-and-cities) have enacted their own Green New Deals. We must pass the Green New Deal at the federal level, and we must keep it in public discourse so that it continues to have a broad impact. To support our campaign and its push for environmental justice, please share this message and follow us: [Follow & share our message](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/pDQqDTBYsqDALzvAONm6p7TUcJN1m0zS/click?signature=61352a1c3935d6ce50513ab6e06595efd5a8d006&url=https%3A%2F%2Flinktr.ee%2Fpaigefornh%3Futm_source%3Dig%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_content%3Dlink_in_bio%26fbclid%3DPAZXh0bgNhZW0CMTEAc3J0YwZhcHBfaWQPOTM2NjE5NzQzMzkyNDU5AAGnwiKr3TdqjvWOCEA9wk4CEx5C5JBlX-tyaTPDCMiVE_4SK8pFYgHqQLIROxc_aem_YugD5GviU9KlQ3oWl1w5qQ) If you can, please make a contribution to our campaign: [Donate](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/pDQqDTBYsqDALzvAONm6p7TUcJN1m0zS/click?signature=6c6bbf7f1426ef5e4e82515019c4e169d76fed74&url=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fpaige-for-congress)
* * *
**Let’s connect and talk about environmental justice, Medicare for All and/or anything else that matters most to you!** Paige has another jam-packed week coming up! Here are some of her stops- **Tuesday August 4**
Paige is swinging by the National Night Out events in both [Salem](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/pDQqDTBYsqDALzvAONm6p7TUcJN1m0zS/click?signature=3cfdd55b0afffb3eb88f9c1d460ca33a651611ec&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.solidarity.tech%2Fahoy%2Fmessages%2FdSuhoKQFY8JOqN9nh5JIkfKaSb2nHn2W%2Fclick%3Fsignature%3D097caff6074d2a2a35eaa1b7cac3ab5bd926bdde%26url%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.salemnh.gov%252Fm%252Fnewsflash%252Fhome%252Fdetail%252F221) and [Hudson](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/pDQqDTBYsqDALzvAONm6p7TUcJN1m0zS/click?signature=5bc15fbc10bb22a26fcc99af01110c342900399d&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.solidarity.tech%2Fahoy%2Fmessages%2FdSuhoKQFY8JOqN9nh5JIkfKaSb2nHn2W%2Fclick%3Fsignature%3D7968948a0b0d1439a5713cde8bb09b776f199676%26url%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.hudsonchamber.com%252Fevents%252Fdetails%252Fnational-night-out-2026-3880). **Thursday August 6** Paige will be at an [Upper Valley Meet and Greet](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/pDQqDTBYsqDALzvAONm6p7TUcJN1m0zS/click?signature=100591ce2a9e1181e733f290d0f50daae8cd3f91&url=https%3A%2F%2Fpaige-for-congress.solidarity.tech%2Fupper-valley-meet-and-greet%3Fevent_session_ids%3D83325) from 5:30-6:45 pm in Hanover. Come meet her there! **Saturday August 8** Catch Paige at [Arts in the Park in Concord](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/pDQqDTBYsqDALzvAONm6p7TUcJN1m0zS/click?signature=f12787d7b9502d9aeb1d775e7f7a5db35aae24b5&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.solidarity.tech%2Fahoy%2Fmessages%2FdSuhoKQFY8JOqN9nh5JIkfKaSb2nHn2W%2Fclick%3Fsignature%3D4a66b27ed21854be5417c5dca852f8e70f7620d6%26url%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fmy.concordnhchamber.com%252Fcommunity-events%252FDetails%252Farts-in-the-park-1719381%253FsourceTypeId%253DWebsite) between 11:30 and 2! Come find her at any (or all!) of these — would love to see you there! Please check our [events page](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/pDQqDTBYsqDALzvAONm6p7TUcJN1m0zS/click?signature=b653748cef12ebd49ee597cbbab86fc6ddeb826c&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.solidarity.tech%2Fahoy%2Fmessages%2FdSuhoKQFY8JOqN9nh5JIkfKaSb2nHn2W%2Fclick%3Fsignature%3D42824ec486de3e80cf51fe3bdc0cffabd53ed954%26url%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.paigefornh.com%252Fcalendar) for more opportunities to meet Paige. In Solidarity, Team Paige

subject: Can you help us reach more voters?
body:
We have just one week left until the primary, and what we do in these final days matters. I’m asking you to help us reach more voters.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/bb5e7341d834/can-you-help-us-reach-more-voters?e=f59034ca3e)
---
[|
---](https://dylanforwi.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a35db0b2063076c807094f7b&id=55ae945a7c&e=f59034ca3e)
| | | | | | Hi Peter,
We have just one week left until the primary, and what we do in these final days matters. I’m asking you to help us reach more voters.
It is critical that as many people as possible know my name and recognize this race, especially in a down-ballot election.
The Governor’s race has taken up a lot of the oxygen so far this year, but there is still time to bring attention to the Treasurer’s race. We need to flip this seat and return this office to one that uses Public Power for the Public Good!
**Here is my ask: Can you please share this email with your circle and text a few friends and family members who you think would support our campaign? Let them know why you support Dylan Helmenstine, the progressive candidate for Treasurer, and ask them to make a plan to vote on or before August 11.**
Every conversation, share, and vote can make a difference in this race. Thank you for helping us get the word out.
**For those who had this forwarded to you, let me introduce myself!**
---
[|
---](https://dylanforwi.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a35db0b2063076c807094f7b&id=729e5bd20f&e=f59034ca3e)
| | My name is **Dylan Helmenstine** , and I am running to be the next Wisconsin State Treasurer. I believe this office must do more for the people of Wisconsin and can play a critical role in bringing greater transparency and accountability to state government. I will be a Treasurer who is in our communities far more than in the Capitol because I believe in bringing government to the people and making state government work for everyone.
**My top three priorities for the Treasurer’s office are to bring government transparency into the 21st century, support and grow public education funding, and protect our state trust funds from political and private interference.**
1. _**Government Transparency:**_ I will bring transparency to the Treasurer’s office by creating a visual, public dashboard for the state budget and Guides to the System that are short, jargon-free explanations of our systems to make them accessible to Wisconsinites.

2. _**Defending Public Education:**_ I have cared deeply about defending our public education system since day one. That is why I originally ran for school board and joined the Wisconsin Association of School Boards, where I rallied 93% of Wisconsin school boards to demand the special education funding our schools were promised but never received. As State Treasurer, I will also work with local leaders to update property tax bills so taxpayers can clearly see how their tax dollars are being diverted to the private school voucher system.

3. _**Protecting and Growing State Trust Funds:**_ I have the experience needed to protect the Common School Trust Fund from political interference. I was appointed by Governor Evers to the Teachers’ Retirement Board of Wisconsin, which helps to oversee the state’s $155 billion public pension fund.
