---
| | Peter,
---
If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left...

If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good...

If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, _" Is it already too late?" _

You're not alone.

A lot of good people have been asking the same question.

**But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... **

Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.

That was no small feat.

Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked.

So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle.

_Then Charlie called me... _

He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster."

I told him, "We are."

Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said, "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!"
I'll be honest -- I froze.

We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet.

But he wasn't fazed.

He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together."

That was Charlie.

He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday."

He believed in going now.

And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself.

He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality.

That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place.

That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- _many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. _

**And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: **
---
[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=e519d45199874d1a873f3cbd46b0c25c&_e=9_srRKIEySRNwYcxCl6GSuKnck_3MhDjBSlQtirKdSM5jQgwtIkKm6Los9RpsL8cngu_K37VyxoXiT_o65dHjswn9JbDlD295-_vuJeW_hT0sj6ffpd_iCIxWt4mkUhZnTEgWYq9vQaSAmnR3d_sPaHyuv7sDr03m8s75Gdd_dHrSZAaH84NFjm518PKtKQF_oh-MZsLu0sgaXYvBJsq2Z-3rSEPLORbLfNOyDs6dPerkhgBzD2OHDCyYNL4adpC2NPH26bOeGf1hCd4ub1j92GnxuCzvTEPfx4-TOPym78dT1fP6iU-azLfgIZiFRCvyTQiOYckYSIpvBIDF3l7uMBeyoPOYh959BM84RHQt1ULGQ5JD6Q6ISWa7yUAU1h4agzu_-bvIYt3PHY56B84bTqooIOBsakvUAi5yKT78gF5xBMV7mnEFOK9PFLYG5Im8VPjncqouU04geuzCc9ZwakCl4xavi9xja1W8yjCgiBY-1a515HRV7MCjNMoP9f8seERmEei38oY-1U6Ivv1FV0uWs6GIbV1j3KF-8mC-7en7i4zxm6xt8CN-6Cjmh8Mo2OVeCqYiFF0GQhs1YdfTFAFyw_n6ufe0puA36PfKOs5a70IRvBDlOl5EeePmm9xsyNBq8XyNVggXIP8-O_j9NqEyFlBr00POZXS6IfjTKlXaU13u8IGnCaT4hMTjDKqE_3IzhIAn9SqtY3I3i9ipvq1SI51uPU_JnqIswiGO0c%3D)
---
We're in 3,300.

That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America.

Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide.

✅ Florida
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee
✅ Oklahoma
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Arkansas
✅ Indiana

And we're just getting started.

Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country...

That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom.

_That 's what Club America is about... _

**Giving the next generation a place where they can find their courage, develop grit, and learn how to lead the fight for their country. **
---
[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=e519d45199874d1a873f3cbd46b0c25c&_e=9_srRKIEySRNwYcxCl6GSuKnck_3MhDjBSlQtirKdSM5jQgwtIkKm6Los9RpsL8cngu_K37VyxoXiT_o65dHjswn9JbDlD295-_vuJeW_hT0sj6ffpd_iCIxWt4mkUhZnTEgWYq9vQaSAmnR3d_sPaHyuv7sDr03m8s75Gdd_dHrSZAaH84NFjm518PKtKQF_oh-MZsLu0sgaXYvBJsq2Z-3rSEPLORbLfNOyDs6dPerkhgBzD2OHDCyYNL4adpC2NPH26bOeGf1hCd4ub1j93adXgjpQrkSjqsqYPLZGVEFfiYtCvytmAFZrpqsNMa1WwfepAc1kinzZ_bAjkdhx10SB-XKU3zREDq6Q3dR1su2b6TpBxz2Ocv2Gyo0xoOIl8Vb4hwtrRa2xsiREZI9X8GlZ_tSGRPQ-38cR4ZKZkRzCWVlOvUtd2YiPjGL_Tpw9vS4t1KZPDY-lZjLPEz2bvyH13u6MEPaJYEtBZsRuu7UATdGhu2NCY-I6P7FsRZNuiBY9dw9mDRBNzKe0WLoy-W4FAfv1_eEpfmAv3K6cbeS0OQ08TmzkaFDKIlEvPlsMi5dM270Tr7nbdYjyvGWrHSM6ZHCIIJFcFvcEfKL22xRSeE0lox_AoI1MkS1jsG5sBGhNzPfLCTYYM0GWLK6GKCCN9JoNyadeDw4vl-OXbNaw4ZuGYkEl6y1vbXCnuCZ9yVOMoYcniipe6SQkAB_un_1l5zdqqN9zmoNl9PVqqQ%3D)
---
_But now, Peter, the question is... _

**What will it take to bring Club America to the next 3,300 schools? What will it take to bring it to all 27,000? **

Because here's the truth:

These students aren't just signing up. _They 're stepping up. _

They're leading chapters in schools where America is attacked... where they're often targeted for daring to say what they believe... and where speaking the truth is dangerous.

But that isn't stopping them.

They're still showing up. They're speaking out. And they're growing stronger than ever.

They're becoming exactly the kind of young patriots Charlie believed in -- not just bold, _but brave_. Not just loud, but _principled_.

**Every time a student starts a new chapter, we make sure they 're not standing alone. **

**We send them an activism kit -- American flags, pocket Constitutions, chapter materials, and leadership tools. **

These kits give student leaders everything they need to rally their peers and stand strong on their campuses.

Each one costs just $25 to pack and ship.

Charlie wanted a Club America chapter in every high school so no student would ever feel alone for loving God, defending their country, or believing in truth.

And so the next generation wouldn't be handed over to the Left by default.

Let's make Charlie's dream real -- 27,000 high schools. And a generation that doesn't apologize for loving this country.

It's up to us to finish what he started.

One chapter. One student. One school at a time.

Let's move faster. Let's push further. Let's get this done -- for Charlie, and for the country we all love.

If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good... A lot of good people have been asking the same question. But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools. That was no small feat. Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked. So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle. Then Charlie called me... He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster." I told him, "We are." Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools." I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America." "Okay," he said, "How many are there?" "About 27,000." Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!" I'll be honest -- I froze. We didn't have the numbers. # [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Summer is still in full swing, Peter.
For many people, that means vacations, long weekends, and taking things a little slower.
But for us, it's**one of the most important times of the campaign.**
With **less than 100 days until Election Day,** and early voting even sooner, our organizers and volunteers are out in communities across the state, talking with voters, knocking on doors, and building the grassroots movement it will take to win this November.

And they're doing it in the Texas heat. In some parts of our state, temperatures are averaging **100 degrees** , but our volunteers continue showing up because they know every conversation brings us one step closer to victory.
Texas is a massive state with more than **18 million registered voters**. Reaching people in every corner of our communities takes a dedicated team, a strong organizing program, and the resources to keep showing up day after day.
That’s where _you_ come in.

I want to tell you something that’s not easy to talk about...
A sitting Republican elected official recently tagged the Department of Homeland Security on social media and wrote:
"I would like to report a foreign occupier. Name: Unpronounceable. Country of origin: Tatooine." He was talking about me. The same official called for the mass deportation of Indian Americans.
I was born in New Delhi. I came to this country as a baby. I grew up in Peoria, Illinois. I went to public schools, got on food stamps for a time with my family, worked my way to Princeton and Harvard Law. I served in government. I got elected to Congress five times.
And someone still looked at all of that and saw a foreign occupier.
I'm telling you this not for sympathy. I'm telling you this because what happened to me is happening to communities all across this country right now, at a scale we have never seen before.
Trump and his MAGA allies have made it clear: if you weren't born here, if your name is hard to pronounce, if you look different or pray differently, you are not fully American in their eyes. They are using the machinery of the federal government to make that point, loudly and cruelly, every single day.
My father came here with nothing. He believed this country would be there for families like ours. It was. Because people fought for it.
That is exactly why I started Equal Opportunity Now.
We need leaders in office who will stand up for immigrant families and for every community that Trump has decided to make an enemy.
Those leaders exist. They are running for office right now. They need our support.
Will you chip in $25 or $50 today to help Equal Opportunity Now back the leaders who won't back down? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-eon]
CHIP IN TODAY TO DEFEAT MAGA EXTREMISM! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-eon]
It’s on us to stop the rising tide of MAGA Extremism. And with your help?
We’ll be unstoppable.
— Raja Krishnamoorthi

_Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona_
---
These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.

clean_body: I wanted you to see this | | | | | Friend, I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground. Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible. Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them. They're already claimed. And we don't have extras. By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in. Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it. That's where things stand right now. We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment. And I don't say that lightly. Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down. The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great. And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing. Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back. We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there. And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet. That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens. And it's not isolated growth anymore. We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America. That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation... And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak. So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build. What's different now is the pace. Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: ✅ Arkansas ✅ Florida ✅ Idaho ✅ Indiana ✅ Montana ✅ Nebraska ✅ Oklahoma ✅ South Carolina ✅ Texas ✅ Tennessee That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action. That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly. It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up. Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through. And right now, that's where we're stretched. We're not lacking interest or momentum. We're working to keep up with both. So here 's how you can help... Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it. An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: ✅ Constitutions. ✅ Chapter guides. ✅ Flags. ✅ Materials to organize and lead. It turns a student who wants to speak up... into one who actually does. And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here." Every activism kit you help sponsor means one more student is ready to lead instead of sitting on the sidelines. That's how we keep saying "yes" when the next student steps forward. That's how this movement actually scales. Because the reality is, the demand is here now. The only question is whether we're equipped to meet it. And that comes down to whether people like you decide to step in and help carry this forward. One final thing: I also wanted to say thank you. If you've supported Turning Point USA before -- whether once or many times -- you've already played a role in building what you're seeing right now. Students finding their voice. More state partnerships. New TPUSA chapters like the one at Charlie's former high school. This kind of momentum doesn't happen without people willing to stand behind it. And we don't take that lightly. I appreciate you taking the time to read this, and for everything you've already done to support this work. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. Friend, what you're seeing right now is something we've been working toward for years -- a generation of young Americans who are no longer willing to sit quietly while the Left dominates their schools and culture. But moments like this don't sustain themselves. If we don't keep up, we lose ground. It's that simple. We need to keep pace with the growth happening right now -- to fund more activism kits, support more chapters, and make sure no student is left standing alone after they decide to speak up. If you've already supported Turning Point USA in the past, thank you for carrying this movement forward every single day. If you haven't yet, I'm asking you to step in now. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

body:
If he wins, he’ll be a rubber stamp for whatever Donald Trump wants...

|
---

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136636222/638084064/504649631?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_MeetOurOpponent_260804_T1_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMzA5Njk4Ni01ZjkwLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4lUUdF-U-4VDCprLhjXGIKfKC_d_L_6IV2JGh7EaeGk=) **BREAKING: Republicans nominate Trump-loyalist Bert “MAGA” Mizusawa for Senate** Derek – haven't heard of Virginia Republicans’ Senate nominee Bert Mizusawa before tonight?

Let’s catch you up:
* For the past six months, Bert “MAGA” Mizusawa has distinguished himself from the Republican field by running as the biggest cheerleader for President Donald Trump and his dangerous agenda.
* He’s a Trump campaign alum who routinely brags about writing President Trump’s foreign policy and believes that the skyrocketing price of gas is “a small price to pay” for Trump’s war-of-choice with Iran.
* He strongly supports the use of taxpayer dollars for President Trump’s gold-plated ballroom.
* He’s called to get rid of the filibuster just to pass the SAVE America Act, Trump’s dangerous voter suppression bill.
* He doesn’t believe Congress should be a check on Donald Trump’s attempted power grab.

| | | Fellow American, My father came to this country with nothing. He had been tortured in a Cuban prison. He fled Fidel Castro's Cuba with the shirt on his back and one belief -- that somewhere on this earth, freedom still existed. He found it here. In America. _He never took a single day of it for granted._ Growing up, my father told me the truth about socialism. Not the version they teach in universities today. The real version. The version he lived. **Socialism promises everything. It delivers nothing** -- except bread lines, secret police, and a government that decides what you're allowed to think, say, and own. He watched it happen to his country. He watched a thriving Cuba -- a country full of life, culture, and promise -- get strangled by the same ideology that the radical left is selling to Americans right now._That's not ancient history. That's a warning._ Because in the summer of 2026, the socialist left isn't hiding anymore. A Democratic Socialist just won the mayor's race in the largest city in America -- on a platform of government control, class warfare, and open contempt for everything that made this country great. His machine has spread into Senate races, congressional primaries, and state legislatures from coast to coast. They are coming for the Republican majority. They are coming for your tax cuts. They are coming to your border. **They believe,_they genuinely believe_ , this is their moment.** **_Socialism promises everything. And right now, it's promising them your country._** My father escaped it once. **I refuse to let it follow him here.** I've spent my entire career standing between the American people and this movement. In the Senate chamber. In the courts. On the national stage. I have never backed down from this fight. But I cannot win it alone.
